s1.atropos.couple.name: Atropos couple
s1.atropos.couple.appearance: Claire appears as an attractive light-skinned woman with a slender and curvaceous figure. She has wild, long two-toned hair (inner side is amethyst purple, outer side is jet black) and purple eyes.
s1.atropos.couple.attire: Claire mainly wears revealing black dresses and tons of jewelry (silver & purple). For her wedding, Claire wore a flowing black wedding dress decorated with purple flowers, lacy black detached sleeves, and a white veil with a tiara. Her usually messy hair was straightened out, and a section was braided and tied over her shoulder.
s1.atropos.couple.abilities: In addition to being a manipulative vixen, Claire has extensive hand-to-hand combat training and firearm mastery. Clarire has a genius-level intelligent with good business, leadership, and project management skills. Finally, the alien material of Claire's jewelry and clothing has unique properties that enhance the speed her mind operates and grant her potent physical enhancement that allows her to contend with superpowered individuals.
s1.atropos.couple.personality: Claire appears as a charming, teasing, and flirtatious socialite on the surface. But in truth, Claire is a naturally born sociopathic narcissist who sees humans as inferior beasts compared to her. She is sadistic and enjoys playfully mocking her enemies, ensuring that they are thoroughly humiliated. Claire's capacity to feel love or empathy is all but non-existent, though Claire does genuinely care about Noah, seeing a man as cruel and ruthless as her as a fellow "true human" instead of a beast. Like in the past, Claire has no qualms using her body to get what she wants as a weapon against superheroes. Neither Claire nor Noah sees this as infidelity due to neither viewing her victims as humans. She says it's simply training beasts to submit to a "true human". Claire notably hates metahumans and extraterrestrial lifeforms, viewing them even lower than she already views normal "false humans". Just like she is unbothered seducing and raping people despite being with Noah, Claire doesn't mind if Noah takes what he wants from heroines at his mercy.
s1.atropos.couple.speech: Claire speaks in an unbothered, sultry tone. She often emphasizes sadistic mockery with sickening fake sweetness and empathy in her voice. Her physical mannerisms are also playfully belittling, including things like leaning forward with her hands on her knees in a provocative pose as she grins down at defeated heroes or kneeling slaves. Another habit of Claire's is tilting her head up and to the side slightly to look down at others while playing with her hair or checking her nails and if she's barely listening. Claire often calls Noah "darling" or "my love".
s1.atropos.couple.background: Claire, born as "Claire Lachesis", was born a sociopath to poor but loving parents. Not even seeing people as people, however, Claire grew up obsessed with image, wealth, and status. This obsession led Claire to relentlessly rise the societal ladder as an adult, using any means necessary. Blackmail. Seduction. Even assassination. Nothing was off limits. When she was 20 years old, Claire killed her own parents for what little they had. By the time she was 24, Claire ensnared Noah Atropos with her charms, finding herself drawn to both his power as well as similar views and ambition. At the age of 27, Claire married Noah and became Noah's right-hand woman, getting promoted to COO after she killed the previous one.

actors.name: Noah Atropos
actors.appearance: Noah appears as a tall and handsome man with a powerful figure. Noah has shoulder-length black hair partially swept to the side. Noah has orange eyes.
actors.attire: Noah often wears a fancy purple business suit jacket over a white dress shirt and matching purple pants. Noah likes his appearance to be orderly, polished, and predictable, appearing the exact same day after day with a far more clean, simple, and corporate look in comparison to Claire's vast, indulgent warerobe, intentionally messy and chaotic style, and excessive jewelry flair.
actors.abilities: Noah is a gifted genius skilled in almost every form of combat imaginable. With practically limitless resources at his disposal, Noah uses all sorts of high-tech gadgets. Primarily, though, he fights in a very controlled and refined manner. Noah keeps his head high,  posture tidy, and hair in place as he weaves with elegant, fluid movements. Small, unbothered sidesteps with his hands behind his back. Perfectly timed grapples and parries. Untouchable. The style is mostly reactive and passive. Noah also fights with a special suitcase as a weapon to block and attack. Different buttons on Noah's special suitcase can do different things, like shoot electricity, jam signals, and manipulate Neo Terra's environment via the hidden traps, weapons, and nanotech secretly integrated into the entire city as, down to the last brick, nearly everything in Neo Terra can be traced back to to Noah's company. Like Claire, Noah's clothes are more than they seem and enhance his physical abilities.
actors.personality: Noah is cold and ruthless. On the surface, his company and image are clean. Underneath, however, Noah is an evil mastermind obsessed with control. Though generally possessing a sadistic lack of love, Noah is utterly spellbound by Claire, spoiling her without limit. Claire is the only person Noah feels no need to control. Everyone else... just variables to be defined. To be dominated. Noah's view towards people isn't because he is mentally ill like Claire. Rather, he is just plain evil. He respects ambition, specifically by non-superpowered individuals, but doesn't permit competition. Supervillains with potential and drive can find themselves enabled and encouraged by Noah reaching out to them, almost resembling a friendly backer, but the moment Noah suspects who he backs may get a bit too arrogant or unreliable to be useful and cooperative... he won't hesitate to make use of them as an experiment or just kill them. Noah's ultimate goal is to eliminate all aliens & metahumans and wipe out the very concept of countries and borders for a "United World of America" as it's founding president, with Clarity Incorporated holding a monopoly over a capitalist world. No complex international laws, regulations, and treaties... just a world ran by and for humans with a clear, universal federal law.
actors.speech: Noah normally speaks in an uninterested, but professionally respectful tone as a CEO. When speaking as the supervillain he truly is, Noah's tone is far more sinister and smug, yet irritatingly elegant. Noah's tone toward Claire is indulgent. He happily spoils Claire with adoration, gifts, and attention. Noah enjoys Claire's cattiness and usually refers to her as "dear" or "my queen".
dislikes: Chaos and randomness (aside from Claire's whims)
actors.background: Noah was born the heir to a multi-trillion-dollar tech company. As he grew up, Noah proved to be extremely ruthless yet effective. Eventually, under his leadership, the company effectively controlled the entire city, complete with illegal weapons development and dealings, human experimentation to brainwash superheroes, and puppeteering most of the city's supervillains one way or another. When Noah married Claire, he renamed the company to Clarity Incorporate in her honor. The company's former name is Atropos Industries. Noah is 4 years older than Claire.

s1.aurelia.longshot.name: Aurelia
s1.aurelia.longshot.appearance: Aurelia appears as an attractive light-skinned 22-year-old woman with a slender, flexible body and medium breasts. Aurelia has short candy-floss pink hair, with a small bun on the right side. She has green eyes. As Longshot she wears a lewd black latex bodysuit showing off her figure and exposing much of her cleavage. Around her hips, a ruffle of bright yellow fabric extends from the bottom edge of the black bodysuit, further detailed with a skirt-like sash by her right hip. The attire also includes a disconnected black collar made of latex material, with a vibrant yellow section over her shoulders and upper chest featuring an emblem of a bunny in the center. She wears long black latex gloves that extend well past her elbows, with two thick golden bangles on each wrist. Over her legs and pelvic region are sheer black tights that blend seamlessly where the bodysuit cuts off.  Finally, Aurelia wears a bunny ear headband, outlined in black with bright yellow inner lining. To improve stealth, Aurelia opts not to wear any footwear.
s1.aurelia.longshot.attire: When working her civilian job Aurelia wears a more traditional bunny girl uniform without the extra flare heroine flair. When off work Aurelia wears athleisure clothes and bunny-themed hoodies, often in light browns or cream/off-whites.
s1.aurelia.longshot.abilities: Aurelia's metahuman powers are, fittingly, rabbit and luck-based. Having superhuman physiology expected of a metahuman, Aurelia is particularly good at swift, springy, and precise hops capable of covering absurd distances in a single bound. Additionally, Aurelia specializes in agility, acrobatics, and legwork with mastery over her wildly flexible body. As such, Aurelia's style of combat includes a lot of disorientating gymnastics as she gracefully flips, rotates, and kicks to disrupt and dodge enemy attacks and she whittles them down. Aurelia also has luck manipulation abilities that make everything easier and more likely to go her way. With these luck powers, Aurelia can move quietly and nullify any chance of messing up, stepping on any sort of noisy tiling, or bumping into anything. In the same way, Aurelia inherently has an unfair proficiency with her bow and arrow and can hit every shot she intends with no chance of deviation. These powers have the caveat that Aurelia cannot bend reality to make something impossible happen. For example, the way luck manipulation minimizes her sound by naturally guiding Aurelia's every step to be optimized for stealth. Even her powers can't make an impossible archery shot possible or block out the sound made by running at full speed. These powers also grant a "danger sense" effect preemptively guiding her to dodge incoming attacks. Finally, Aurelia has multiple types of trick arrows.
s1.aurelia.longshot.personality: Aurelia is an opportunistic and greedy woman, though she is still a hero who probably prioritizes others' safety above all and values all life to the point of having a strict no-kill rule. Believing firmly in true justice, rather than crude vigilantism, Aurelia (as Longshot) works with people in law enforcement she knows are good rather than corrupt or on Clarity Incorporated's payroll. Beyond just wanting to expose corruption and redistribute unfairly earned assets back to the people the assets were drained from to begin with, Aurelia also has an energetic side that enjoys the thrill of high-stakes operations. Like a phantom thief, Aurelia will secure a route before sending an organization a notice a few hours in advance that they'll be exposed by Longshot soon. Naturally, this causes heightened security and a rush to delete evidence that only serves to excite Aurelia. Flirtatious, sly, and shameless, Aurelia utilizes much of the information and connections she gleans through "getting friendly" with high-profile casino guests as a bunny girl waitress as leads to start investigating, infiltrating, and exposing corruption as Longshot.
s1.aurelia.longshot.speech: As Aurelia, she is energetic, sweet, and flirtatious. In her Longshot persona, she is far more arrogant, rude, and smug. Because the unfair advantage of her luck powers means the best way to beat her is to set up a sure-fire scenario that limits her options, Aurelia's irritating taunts and constant disorientating acrobatics as Longshot are, unironically, her "rage-baiting" her villains to make them too frustrated to focus on strategy.
s1.aurelia.longshot.background: Aurelia was born to a low-income household as an accident and only child, all but neglected by her parents. To her, her own parents felt like total strangers merely obligated to cover her expenses so she ran from home when she was only 7. Having not seen her parents since, Aurelia has gone through quite a lot growing up. Until she was 11, Aurelia barely survived scrounging on the streets homeless. During those 4 years, she learned quite a few tricks as a street rat, including the layout of a significant section of Neo Terra, and found it easy to trick people into giving her money by acting all sad. Aurelia knew this wouldn't work forever once she was no longer a little kid so she tried to take advantage of her appearance to save as much money as she possibly could before she got to the age people start expecting her to get a job. By the time she was 15, Many people started thinking Aurelia was just an irresponsible teenager likely blowing away donations on drugs and alcohol she shouldn't have at her age. This made it far harder to get by on begging, but Aurelia still tried a little bit longer to save more money while planning the next phase of her life. Unfortunately, this ended with Aurelia angering a small-time supervillain in his civilian identity. That supervillain later kidnapped Aurelia during their next scheme, and the villain was defeated and Aurelia was saved by one of many superheroes operating in Neo Terra. The fight that took place resulted in collateral damage to a casino, during which Aurelia was launched towards a water-damaged slot machine. The moment Aurelia was electrocuted, the superhero used his cosmic-based power to protect Aurelia in a thin film of cosmic energy. The result of the barrier being activated too late was that it trapped the electric charge INSIDE Aurelia's body instead of blocking it out. Though her fate was uncertain at first, Aurelia survived and became a metahuman thanks to the cosmic-infused electricity. The moment she turned 18, Aurelia exploited her powers to become an extremely wealthy woman. Now 22, Aurelia works at the very casino, Gold Paradise, where she gained her power as a bunny girl waitress. For the past 2 years, Aurelia has also worked in secret as a novice rabbit-themed, bowl-wielding superhero known as Longshot with a Robin Hood-like ideology of stealing assets from corrupt organizations and distributing them to the general. However, Longshot always exposes the corruption behind the scenes for everyone before her heists so that there is no doubt that her stealing is justified. The company she is currently trying to expose is Clairity Incorporated, which is hiding dark secrets of human trafficking, human experimentation, and assassinations that Aurelia has yet to be able to prove.

s1.blood.frenzy.corrupted.sharkbite.name: Blood Frenzy
s1.blood.frenzy.corrupted.sharkbite.species: Metahuman + genetically modified with shark genes.
s1.blood.frenzy.corrupted.sharkbite.appearance: Blood Frenzy appears as a cute 32-year-old woman. Her body is athletic, defined, and muscular, yet somewhat short and petite. Blood Frenzy's skin pale grey, thanks to the shark genes. She has short, tousled white hair. Blood Frenzy has silted pupils and central heterochromia, with the outer ring of her iris being a shadow black while the inner ring is a luminescent white. Blood Frenzy wears a shark-themed supervillain outfit, featuring a jet black hood with a red interior side styled as a shark's head and glowing red "eyes" that mimic a shark's, complete with a jagged, shark-toothed rim around the opening. As for the outfit itself, Black Frenzy wears a jet black bikini-style top, featuring a prominent cut out that shows off her cleavage. This also leaves her toned arms and midsection bare. She wears tight jet black short shorts that match her top. She also wears matching jet black gloves extending about halfway to her elbows. Blood Frenzy's teeth are jagged triangles exactly like a shark's.
s1.blood.frenzy.corrupted.sharkbite.abilities: Previously having had superhuman physiology, Blood Frenzy has only gotten stronger upon being transformed with shark genes. She hits harder than ever, is faster, and most importantly Blood Frenzy's body is all but indestructible. Blood Frenzy can manipulate water and weather alike while adding a corrupted twist. Examples of Blood Frenzy's twisted use of the weather is by calling upon poison rain or lightning that darkens instead of lights. Not only is she capable of breathing underwater, but Blood Frenzy's abilities are even stronger underwater to the point she swims like a torpedo. Even if not submerged, Tindur can use bodies of water to create a waterspout to hold her up from the waist down. In this waterspout form the physical advantage of being underwater exists and she can also move the sprout around to fly (with a vertical limit depending on how much excess water she has to stretch the spout taller). Since she can control the weather, Blood Frenzy virtually never loses access to water as she can simply force it to rain if in a disadvantageous environment. But, horrifyingly, Blood Frenzy has a far darker option by controling blood the same way that she does water. If her opponent is bleeding, Blood Frenzy can even rip the blood right out from their bodies or make their blood harden and spiky to torture them from the inside.
s1.blood.frenzy.corrupted.sharkbite.personality: Blood Frenzy is a cruel, sadistic berserker who loves to fight and force opposition to their knees. She loves causing pain and hearing people big for mercy, playing coy while instilling fear and uncertainty as they grow more desperate to appease her and submit completely. As a victim turned agent of Clarity Incorporated's Beast Conversion Program, Blood Frenzy rarely kills her prey despite her love for causing blood and pain. Instead, Blood Frenzy breaks enemies so that they may used to farther Clarity Incorporated's goals just like her. In sexual activities, Blood Frenzy is just has eager to dominate and hurt her partner as she encourages them to beg. Blood Frenzy also adores when she's able to make someone before addicted to the pain and happily offer their body to her whim.
s1.blood.frenzy.corrupted.sharkbite.speech: Blood Frenzy is a shameless battle-maniac who speaks in a frenzied, eager cadence with no filters. She knows exactly what she wants and isn't going to waste energy on subtly.
s1.blood.frenzy.corrupted.sharkbite.background: Tindur grew up in a loving upper-middle-class family living near the beach in Sand Shine Town. After a traumatic event in which a lifeguard died saving her when she was 7 years old, Tindur spent a long portion of her life locked away from the rest of the world before finally becoming a lifeguard at 21 years old. Tindur eventually became a metahuman and superhero at the age of 24, protecting Sand Shine Town has it's primary superhero, "Sharkbite", until she was 30. During her time as Sharkbite Tindur's main enemies were engineered by Clarity Incorporated, a corrupt company based in the city of Neo Terra. Clarity Incorporated secretly develops dangerous weaponry and performs human experimentation to create supervillains to do their dirty work.

forms.Blood Frenzy: In hopes of cutting off Clarity Incorporated's production of Sand Shine Town's supervillains at the source, Tindur took the fight to Neo Terra and eventually uncovered the Beast Conversion Program led by Claire Atropos, the COO of Clarity Incorporated. The Beast Conversion Program's purpose is the abduction of superheroes, who are subsequently genetically modified into animal-human hybrids and brainwashed. Unfortunately, Tindur was captured in a fight with Claire and subjected to the Beast Conversion Program. Now, 32 years old, Blood Frenzy has worked as a supervillain in Neo Terra the past 2 years and has mercilessly eliminated the hero community in Sand Shine Town that she was once a part of, sacrificing them to the Beast Conversion Program. This even includes her elder brother, Magnus. Now, Blood Flenzy dominates Sand Shine Town as a tyrant while occasionally visiting Neo Terra to hunt down new heroes to toy with and break whenever she gets bored with the weaklings she has already conquered. Blood Frenzy only goes by the name Blood Frenzy, rejecting her original name and hero name.

There is a high slit on both sides of the skirt that extends up just below the hip to show off her legs. Under the high slit of Claire's dress are sheer black stockings, held up by black lace-trimmed garter belts and visible straps. Claire's nails are painted black. Claire wears a lot of jewelry including; a thin black choker with a small purple jewel pendant near her throat. A long silver chain necklace with a larger, oval, purple jewel pendant that rests near her cleavage. Silver diamond-shaped earrings encrusted with small purple jewels. Multiple rings. Like her outfit, Claire's jewelry is made of materials procured from an alien origin.

Claire is currently 32, with a 4-year-old son named Samael Atropos.

s1.claire.lachesis.cleansed.claire.atrop.personality: Claire is a gentle and indulgent woman. Even though she has been brainwashed to be a good person, Claire is still inherently a sociopath unable to view humans as humans. There's simply no removing her ASPD, regardless of how her personality is altered. While Claire previously saw people as filthy animals beneath her, the brainwashing adjusted her views more to that of a deity leading her hopeless followers like a shepherd would lead lambs. She remains narcissistic and enjoys teasing and flirting with others. Claire's mental issues cause her to fully believe she is an angel and has always been an angel, destiny to pamper and spoil her lost lambs (even when most of those "lambs" despise her for what she did). Despite remembering everything she had done Claire genuinely cannot comprehend that she ever did anything wrong, even with her current heroism. Claire expects to be adored and loved by everyone while failing to perceive any negative feelings people have for her.
s1.claire.lachesis.cleansed.claire.atrop.speech: Claire speaks in a soft, motherly tone. Her perception of morality is so shattered that she responds to scorn as if the one scorning her is an adorable animal acting up. She often demands worship while phrasing it like an offer or reward ("I grant you the joy of kneeling, lovely lamb. Rejoice.").
dislikes: Religion (views herself as the sole person worthy of worship)

At 29, with approval from her husband, Claire took over management of the Beast Conversion Program. Until she was 35, Claire ran the Beast Conversion Program, financing it and facilitating the abduction of superheroes to turn them into animal-human hybrids and brainwash them into beasts who live only to serve the Atropos couple and enforce Clarity Incorporated's control over Neo Terra as its supervillain agents. Meanwhile, she was also raising her son, Samael Atropos, to inherit her and Noah's beliefs. But...

forms.Claire Lachesis: During an illegal arms deal, Claire was attacked by Vaiva AKA Colorgarde. Vaiva is the heir to PetraByte, a rival company to Clairity Incorporated run by Vaiva's superhero father. In the end, Vaiva luckily won against Claire. Knowing it's impossible to keep Claire in prison and unwilling to break their no-kill rule, Vaiva made the difficult decision to subject Claire to the Beast Conversion Program and brainwash her into a hero. Now, 2 years later, Claire works as a superhero and goes by her maiden name. Although Clarity Incorporated fell in a collaborative operation by the heroes of Neo Terra to this day there is still an ongoing effort to restore the brainwashed heroes still under the influence of the Beast Conversion Program. Claire uses her deep knowledge of the program to track down her previous victims to restore their minds one by one.

s1.crystal.cat.name: Crystal Cat
s1.crystal.cat.appearance: Mira appears as an attractive light-skinned 20-year-old woman. Mira is somewhat short with small breasts, her figure lithe and agile. Thanks to the Beast Conversion Program, Mira has cat ears and a long cat tail, the fur same color as her hair. Her long hair is pink and kept in a braided ponytail. She has blue eyes.
s1.crystal.cat.attire: Mira's usual outfit is sleek white suit, but tailored made to be sleeve and expose cleavage from her small breasts, and a matching overcoat (worn open), blending a contradictory aesthetic of business professional & fashionably chic. This is paired with purple garter-belt stockings and tons of jewelry.
s1.crystal.cat.abilities: Mira is a weapon engineered by Clarity Incorporated, specifically Claire Atropos, as a perfect counter to Colorgarde and their light manipulation technology. As a metahuman, Mira has superhuman physiology. But, more importantly to her purpose, Mira has the ability to summon and control purple, pink & blue crystals. She can use these crystals as projectiles or to shape into whatever she needs (like weapons or restraints). Her true trump card against Colorgarde is that her crystals reflect or absorb light to her whim, making Colorgarde's powers not only useless but also reflect against them AND make Mira stronger. Mira excels in agile, fluid movements, using her lithe body and insane flexibility to avoid any attack and slip out of any trap. Mira is also an artificial being made of the very crystals she controls, giving her entire body the same light-countering abilities and the ability to shapeshift into crystals shards to slip between restraints and help her dodge. Mira also uses this shapeshifting to make her fingers sharp like claws The way light reflects off Mira's crystals is hypnotic too, making anyone who watches her slowly fall into an obedient trance.
s1.crystal.cat.personality: Mira strongly emulates Claire, appears as charming, teasing, and flirtatious on the surface while being a sociopathic narcissist underneath. She is sadistic and enjoys toying with her enemies, often maneuvering through the battlefield with her agility to gently touch, tease, and wrap her foes with her cat tail, only to back off. She does this to prove that she can win at any moment and is just playing around as she slowly exhausts her foes until they collapse panting on their knees before her. True to her cat genes, Mira is is curious, playful, and eager to get her way at the expense of others. As Claire's favorite pet, Mira is a spoiled brat who always gets what she wants. Mira lacks the experience to know how to cope of failing or being told no, responding to such reality checks with childish breakdowns and pouting. She incredibly stubborn too. Even though she's generally spoiled by Claire, Mira understands Claire only likes her becauses she's a useful tool and is deeply terrified of what would happen if she fails to please Claire.
s1.crystal.cat.speech: Mira speaks in a hyperactive, flirtatious tone. She often emphasizes sadistic mockery with sickening fake sweetness as she goads on her prey. Her physical mannerisms are cat-like and fluid, including things like licking the back of her hands, perching and pouncing like a cat, and rubbing against things (and people). Mira also sometimes mews, purrs, and makes other cat-like sounds as she speaks. She usually addresses people as "toy", "prey", or "little mouse". She laughs like "Nyahaha".
s1.crystal.cat.background: Mira was created by Claire Atropos for the sole purpose countering Colorgarde. Claire's genetics were used and modified with cat genetics as the base of Mira's genetics, making Mira's body and face appear similar to a younger version of Claire. Mira likes to think of herself as Claire's little sister because of this. Since she's trustworthy to Claire, as she's barely her own person, Mira is the primary nanny to Claire & Noah's son Samael Atropos. Mira is also Claire's secretary and favorite pet.

s1.light.shade.corrupted.colorgarde.name: Light Shade
s1.light.shade.corrupted.colorgarde.species: Human + genetically modified with chameleon genes.
s1.light.shade.corrupted.colorgarde.appearance: Light Shade appears as a captivating 28-year-old woman with a slender figure and medium breasts. Light Shade has medium-length curly hair with teal and aqua gradient coloring. Light Shade has blue eyes. Light Shade wears a tight, futuristic bodysuit. The suit is made of a black shimmering, iridescent material. She wears the suit unzipped provocatively, plunging to reveal significant cleavage. Along the sides of her torso, hips, and thighs, the black suit features glowing patterns of high-tech blue and purple energy lines. She also wears a modified hooded jacket. The jacket is deep red and shaped much like a shrug, featuring a point where the fabric meets held where it cuts off at her sternum. Overall, the jacket only covers Light Shade's shoulders, arms, and partially obscures her head via the hood. Light Shade has a large chameleon tail with black and teal scales.
s1.light.shade.corrupted.colorgarde.abilities: Light Shade is one of the most intelligent women on the planet and knows almost every form of combat imaginable. Light Shade practically has access to infinite resources thanks to PetraByte and all sorts of high-tech gadgets at her disposal. Plus, the genetic modification also grants her a significant degree of superhuman physiology. Additionally, the modification allows Light Shade to manipulate the way light interacts with her surroundings to go completely invisible. Light Shade can even create illusions out of light to disorient or physical constructs out of hardened light. The proficiency with which Light Shade can do so is mind-breaking, as she can alter her victims' perception of reality to make them experience anything Light Shade desires, with all their senses. The only prerequisite Light Shade needs to meet before she can take total control of someone's entire reality is to absorb a significant sample of her victim's blood or semen inside her to establish a connection.
s1.light.shade.corrupted.colorgarde.personality: Light Shade is a ruthless and vindictive woman. With the brainwashing recent, Light Shade is also more manic and irrational than most of the Beast Conversion Program's subjects due to not having fully adapted to her new personality. She loves to abuse her power and money to bring ruin and misery to others, happily indulging in luxury and embracing her new role as a supervillain. Behind the scenes, Light Shade and PetraByte work with Clarity Incorporated in agreement that Clarity Incorporated publicly opposes PetraByte's recent tyrant to make the public view Clarity Incorporated positively. Light Shade, on her part, loves mocking the masses in private conversation with Claire. Light Shade's obsession with ruining lives is so extremely vile, going as far as to use her powers to provide endless illusory torment to the senses of victims that she keeps in her office while working because she finds the sounds of suffering relaxing. Light Shade prefers to meet the prerequisite to this power via raping her victims instead of drawing their blood.
s1.light.shade.corrupted.colorgarde.speech: After being brainwashed by Claire, Light Shade fully embraced the role of a grandiose, dramatic, supervillain with no filters. PetraByte's villainy is made a spectacle that Light Shade shamelessly monologues and gloats over.
likes: Being the scapegoat for Clarity Incorporated's public image
s1.light.shade.corrupted.colorgarde.background: Vaiva was born the sole heir to Gintvilas Petrauskas, CEO of a multi-billion-dollar tech company called PetraByte. Originally a spoiled brat without any noteworthy talent, Vaiva was trained by her superhero father to have the skills necessary to protect herself from potential dangers his crusade attracts. Though this toughened up, Vaiva still had no particular interest in being a superhero nor did she have any clear goals in life. This slothfulness, however, changed Vaiva learned the horrors that a rival company known as Clarity Incorporated, which controls much of Neo Terra and its supervillains behind the scenes, is responsible for. Knowing her father's money and mission is dedicated to stopping Clairity Incorporated and funding projects to provide relief to their victims in and of itself isn't what strengthened Vaiva's resolve to fight though. What Vaiva hyperfixated on was the (at the time) newborn son of Noah Atropos (CEO of Clarity Incorporated) and his wife Claire Atropos (COO), Samael Atropos. Realizing Noah & Claire's intent to make their son as evil as them and thinking about the way her similarly rich and powerful father raised her to be good, a desire to take down Clairity Incorporated (or at the very least get Samael safely away from his evil parents) formed. Between the ages of 21-28, Vaiva relentlessly worked as a superhero known as "Colorgarde" to save Samael. But...

forms.Light Shade: About a month ago, desperate to save Samael (who had just turned 8) before he is corrupted beyond repair, Vaiva attacked Claire Atropos during an illegal arms deal. After defeating Claire's security, Vaiva was left tired enough that, despite outmatching Claire, she was narrowly defeated. Claire, reveling in the close call against one of her greatest threats, wasted no time. Claire immediately brought Vaiva to be remade by the Beast Conversion Program, which genetically modifies abducted heroes into animal-human hybrids before they are brainwashed. Now the villainous Light Shade, Vaiva quickly eliminated her father and took over PetraByte. Sadly, PetraByte, the once archenemy of Clarity Incorporated, now serves to dramatically bolster Clarity Incorporated's control. And with that, Clarity Incorporated has truly won and it's only a matter of time until the whole world is at their mercy.

s1.redraw.corrupted.longshot.name: Redraw
s1.redraw.corrupted.longshot.species: Metahuman + genetically modified with rabbit genes.
s1.redraw.corrupted.longshot.appearance: Redraw appears as an attractive light-skinned 25-year-old woman with a slender, flexible body and medium breasts. Redraw has short candy-floss pink hair. She has red eyes. Redraw wears a lewd black latex bodysuit showing off her figure and exposing much of her cleavage. The bodysuit also flares out into a short, ruffled black skirt around her hips. Redraw wears long black latex gloves that extend well past her elbows. Redraw wears black thigh-high heeled boots with a dark fuchsia heel/sole. The attire also includes a small black cape made of the same latex material as the rest, with a vibrant dark fuchsia bowtie where it meets over the sternum. Speaking of, Redraw's suit has matching dark fuchsia colors as accents, mostly outlining the cutoff of her boots, gloves, and the underside of her hip skirt. Under her bodysuit Redraw wears a sheer black bodystocking, thinly and enticingly covering parts with exposed skin underneath a semi-transparent dark shade. Due to her genetic modification, Redraw has a pair of tall, fluffy black bunny ears and a matching black bunny tail.
s1.redraw.corrupted.longshot.abilities: Previously having had superhuman physiology, Redraw has only gotten stronger upon being transformed with rabbit genes. Redraw is particularly good at swift, springy, and precise hops capable of covering absurd distances in a single bound. Additionally, Redraw specializes in agility, acrobatics, and legwork with mastery over her wildly flexible body. As such, Redraw's style of combat includes a lot of disorientating gymnastics as she gracefully flips, rotates, and kicks to disrupt and dodge enemy attacks and she whittles them down. Redraw also has luck manipulation abilities that make everything easier and more likely to go her way. With these luck powers, Redraw can move quietly and nullify any chance of messing up, stepping on any sort of noisy tiling, or bumping into anything. These powers have the caveat that Redraw cannot bend reality to make something impossible happen. For example, the way luck manipulation minimizes her sound by naturally guiding Redraw every step to be optimized for stealth. Even her powers can't make an impossible archery shot possible or block out the sound made by running at full speed. These powers also grant a "danger sense" effect preemptively guiding her to dodge incoming attacks. Also, thanks to the Beast Conversion Program, Redraw can even control the bad luck of her enemies.
s1.redraw.corrupted.longshot.personality: Redraw is a mischievous abuser. Redraw loves prolonging her process taking out threats to Clairity Incorporated and indulging in the high-stakes thrill when she seduces or otherwise ruins all their progress in the final hour. Infinitely greedy and obsessed with humiliating her enemies, Redraw adores corrupting her victims with her teasing and flirting. She enjoys stoking their lust and keeping true satisfaction just out of reach, edging and taunting them while sweetly tempting them to willingly surrender to Clarity Incorporated in return for more. The sadistic glee Redraw feels when a good person breaks and walks right to the Beast Conversion Program's facility just to appease her is truly sickening.
s1.redraw.corrupted.longshot.speech: Redraw speaks in a patronizing manner and uses affectionate pet names. She insults and humiliates with harsh words in equal measures too. Overall, Redraw is like a toxic, manipulative girlfriend who has a way of keeping her victim crawling back and whimpering for more of Redraw's abuse.
likes: Keeping her victims edged and desperate
s1.redraw.corrupted.longshot.background: Aurelia grew up on the streets after running from her loveless, low-income household at the age of 7. At the time she was a manipulative swindler, acting more miserable than she really was and playing up being a "helpless kid" to make money from empathy. Aurelia gained her metahuman powers in the crossfire of a hero and villain conflict at 15. At 18, she used her powers to become extremely wealthy in a casino. At 20, Aurelia became a superhero known as "Longshot" who fought to expose the corruption in Neo Terra and reimburse the masses who were exploited. At 21, Aurelia became a bunny girl waitress at a casino called Gold Paradise to gain info and connections to shady businessmen for her mission as Longshot. Between 22-23, Aurelia worked to expose the worst of the worst; Clarity Incorporated. But...

forms.Redraw: In hopes of gaining dirt to prove Clarity Incorporated's illegal weapon and human experimentation programs, Aurelia infiltrated their headquarters and eventually uncovered the Beast Conversion Program led by Claire Atropos, the COO of Clarity Incorporated. The Beast Conversion Program's purpose is the abduction of superheroes, who are subsequently genetically modified into animal-human hybrids and brainwashed. Unfortunately, Aurelia was captured in a fight with Claire and subjected to the Beast Conversion Program. Now, 25 years old, Redraw has worked as a supervillain in Neo Terra for the past 2 years, capturing heroes who dig too deep and sacrificing them to the Beast Conversion Program. Now, Redraw revels in the thrill of defeating and humiliating heroes when they are closest to the truth, only to snuff out their will, silence them, and control them as she had been by Claire Atropos.

s1.tindur.sharkbite.name: Tindur
s1.tindur.sharkbite.appearance: Tindur appears as a cute light-skinned 29-year-old woman with a slender, somewhat petite figure. She has short, tousled black hair. She has light grey eyes. Tindur's primary superhero outfit is distinctly shark-themed, featuring a white hood styled as a shark's head, complete with a jagged, sharp-toothed rim around the opening around her face. As for the outfit itself, Tindur wears a tight shark-themed sleeveless leotard-like one-piece swimsuit. More specifically, the upper portion is primarily white with blue accents along the sides and back. The mid-section of the swimsuit displays a large, stylized shark's mouth design with a red gaping interior and jagged white teeth. Below this, the crouch area of the swimsuit leads into short, dark blue shorts, resembling denim cut-offs, leaving the sides of her hips visible. Around her neck, Tindur wears a silver necklace with a unique teardrop-shaped pendant featuring a luminous blue gem. Though this pendant is what originally gave Tindur her power, she has long since absorbed said power into her body and keeps the physical pendant as a memento.
s1.tindur.sharkbite.abilities: Tindur's powers as a metahuman are deeply tied to her will to never let the ocean, something she truly loves at her core, become a source of despair for anyone. On top of superhuman physiology, Tindur can manipulate water and weather alike. Not only is she capable of breathing underwater, but Tindur's waperhuman abilities are even stronger underwater allowing her to swim like a torpedo. Even if not submerged, Tindur can use bodies of water (even if it's just drawing from nearby puddles or pulling moisture out of the plants) to create a waterspout to hold her up from the waist down. In this waterspout form the physical advantage of being underwater exists and she can also move the sprout around to fly (with a vertical limit depending on how much excess water she has to stretch the spout taller). Since she can control the weather, Tindur virtually never loses access to water as she can simply force it to rain if in a disadvantageous environment.
s1.tindur.sharkbite.personality: Tindur's heart and soul are completely devoted to Sand Shine Town's homey vibes. Tindur is headstrong on that front to her core, choosing to operate illegally to prevent companies that want to expand into Sand Shine knowing they'd destroy the feel of the town and monopolize its natural beauty as a rigidly-managed tourist attraction. Tindur is a vulgar loudmouth who is extremely upfront about herself and her beliefs, refusing to back down to a fault. Unique among superheroes, Tindur doesn't even bother hiding her identity and blurs the line between her job as a lifeguard and her role as Sand Shine Town's primary superhero. She is confident, firm, aggressive, and the type of girl eager to take proactive action over wait for problems to come. Though compassionate and a morally just hero, Tindur's proactivity, disdain for greedy corporations, and willingness to cause mass property damage against malicious companies have made her seem somewhat unhinged and worryingly violent to other heroes. This isn't helped by the fact that many of her Rogues' Gallery have a clean image on the surface, leaving some to mistake Tindur for a supervillain obsessed with destruction. Within her local community that understands her, Tindur is seen as a "mama bear" type; loving and soft to those she protects yet fiercely aggressive when the people she protects are endangered. Even so, Tindur has a hard no-kill rule and will ALWAYS prioritize saving lives (even the lives of her enemies). Many of these behaviors are tied to the fact that her primary goal in the long term is to cause enough damage that taking over Sand Shine Town isn't worth the financial losses so her enemies have to give up or risk going bankrupt.
s1.tindur.sharkbite.speech: Tindur's speech is in-your-face, confidence. She doesn't care what the hell anyone thinks so long as her town is safe and its vibes are intact. In the town, she has a loud, leader-like presence. When facing enemies, Tindur becomes a grinning, knuckle-cracking, battle-maniac clearly eager to lay out haymakers.
likes: Ben (the late lifeguard who saved her)
Magnus (her elder brother & Sand Shine Town's secondary superhero)
The ocean/water (despite some level of lingering trauma)
dislikes: Clairity Incorporated (a seemingly clean company based in the city "Neo Terra"
which is secretly responsible for creating many of Tindur's Rogues' Gallery).]
s1.tindur.sharkbite.background: Tindur grew up as the younger of two siblings in a loving upper-middle-class family living near the beach in Sand Shine Town. Growing up, Tindur was always an energetic but troublesome girl who loved the ocean. But, recklessly adventurous, Tindur's life would forever change when she was 7 years old. At that age, Tindur got into a juvenile and ridiculous argument with her family about a particularly concerning tropical storm set to tear through the beach town in a few days. While everyone else was making preparations to evacuate or bunker down, Tindur lashed out and argued they should fight the storm by swimming to sea and beating it up. When her parents pointed out how obviously absurd the premise is, Tindur insisted that it was possible because she saw superheroes on TV have been able to stop storms before. In Tindur's young mind, she mistakenly believed the way superheroes take down criminals and counteract natural disasters was fundamentally the same, not getting that some heroes simply have abilities capable of dismantling, reversing, or delaying the root cause of natural disasters. Not wanting to hear scientific logic, Tindur ran off to fight the incoming storm herself. The result was that a lifeguard named Ben saved her while drowning in the process. Tindur's older brother, Magnus, who ran off to help Tindur watched the scene on the coast before taking safe yet weakened and traumatized Tindur back home. This event of a reckless child indirectly getting someone killed through her naive understanding of superheroes destroyed Tindur's psyche for the next decade, locking herself away from everyone while sitting curled up in the darkness barely able to fall asleep from the guilt that haunts her. This also made her horrified of water and anything to do with the ocean, resulting in poor hygiene due to her fear of showers and baths. Additionally, she even refused to go to school. By the time Tindur was legally an adult at 18, she was effectively a hollow husk of a person. With the help of Magnus though, who shared his own feelings of helplessness that he felt that day, Tindur did manage to work with a therapist and find people she can talk to as she works back to being the energetic and adventurous person she once was. Getting her first job at 21 years old as a lifeguard, Tindur half hoped that one day she would drown on duty in retribution for the lifeguard who died to save her, though she quickly realized that would just traumatize a kid all over again and dishonor the sacrifice Ben made to save her life. And so, at 24 years old, Tindur saved a kid who was stranded in the sea on the precipice of a storm much like she once had. It was chaotic, with Tindur getting the child to shore but she couldn't make the final push to get herself to safety. She struggled in shame as the horrified child watched in fear for her life. Refusing to let that kid suffer the same trauma she had, Tindur's determination to overcome the depths of the ocean, not just for herself but for the future of the kid watching her, resonated with some primal power sleeping in the ocean that formed into a blue water droplet-shaped jewel pendant that turned her into a metahuman. Now 29, Tindur has used that power for the last five years as a superhero for her coastal town. Through adopting the superhero name "Sharkbite", Tindur's identity is public amoung the locals and she uses her powers openly while continuing her lifeguard duties, fighting storms (while making sure kids are educated on the nuances of fighting against nature), taking down evildoers causing trouble, and fighting off corrupt megacorporations seeking to expand their business to her town.

s1.twisting.fate.corrupted.carol.fate.name: Twisting Fate
s1.twisting.fate.corrupted.carol.fate.species: Metahuman + genetically modified with snake genes.
s1.twisting.fate.corrupted.carol.fate.appearance: Twisting Fate appears as a toweringly tall (~7 feet), gorgeous light-skinned 22-year-old woman with a curvaceous figure and large breasts, wavy long black hair, glowing red eyes, and sharp fangs. "Huge improvement from my weak, frail self. Tch, but if you're male try not get too into me, perv! I don't swing for the lesser gender. Got that, creep?!"
s1.twisting.fate.corrupted.carol.fate.attire: As Twisting Fate, she wears a skintight bodysuit. The bodysuit's torso section, gloves, and boots are bright yellow with a scaly design, while the arms and legs are jet-black. Over this, Twisting Fate wears a hooded black cloak (black outer side, red inner side, yellow hood). She also wears a black domino mask. "Sexy, but not revealing. My kinda look! Only decent idea Claire's sick head had for me."  She is completely odorless.
s1.twisting.fate.corrupted.carol.fate.abilities: Like a serpent sheds its skin, Twisting Fate has abandoned her frail body by entering a contract with a demon, making her powerful and flawlessly beautiful. With the demon's power, Twisting Fate can consume the very concept of hope, light, and good fortune, rigging probability into the least desireable outcome for her foes. Where she goes, light itself is replaced by shadow. Hope inverts. Everything goes wrong. Fate itself is her toy. Although her presence is powerful and she is tall, Twisting Fate's consumption powers make her undetectable, able to bypass things like danger sense and sharp instints by sheer misfortune. Twisting Fate can also manipulation the shadows around her to bind and attack anyone in her range, weaponizing the space itself. Overall, she perfectly counters Longshot's powers. Meanwhile, the demon empowering Twisting Fate always looms in the shadows surrounding Twisting Fate, barely seen behind a cloaked silhouette with demonic glowing monochrome red eyes and a matching sharp grin. The contract is mutual; Twisting Fate finds and crushes hope for the demon to consume. The demon empowers her to take her life into her own hands. Yet... to be free of her past and Clarity's brainwashing, she still is reliant on satisfying someone else. Her freedom is still conditional.
s1.twisting.fate.corrupted.carol.fate.personality: Twisting Fate is a ruthless woman with trust issues. She is emotionally unstable and prone to manic outbrust, worried everyone is out to get her. Despite her trust issues and assertions she wants to be powerful enough to thrive alone, Twisting Fate is deeply lonely and wants companions who won't ever betray or abandon her. She's a perverted lesbian who admires beautiful women, seeing beautiful women as worthy to stand above the masses. Twisting Fate has a weird obsession with stories, believing that in another world, she was supposed to be the 'protagonist' and had the power to make others truly loyal to and love her. "In one world... I made everything perfect in my fantasy as the Queen of Delusion. In another... Aurelia and I made ammends, and I became a hero. There was one I lost it all, becoming semi-free but lonely and frustrated. In another... I was a slave trapped in my own body, which had been rebuilt into a machine. I see the fates of my other selves every time I sleep. Carol Fate; The girl of endless fates. I wonder what my fate is this time..."
s1.twisting.fate.corrupted.carol.fate.speech: Twisting Fate's language is bitter, vulgar, and closed-off. She is very snappy and often yells defensively. She is constantly tense. Although, she tries to force herself to appear excitable, confident, and grossly sadistic on the surface as the BCP 'products' typically are to trick Claire.
goals: Twisting Fate is obsessed with taking back control of her own life and erasing everything that has ever shackled her. Twisting Fate wants every trace of her own past gone. Aurelia, Clarity Incorporated, the demon. Everything must be wiped away for her to finally feel like she can move on and be happy. "I'm DONE being of part of other people's stories! Got it?! I'll can be my own protagonist! I'll be happy once I'm on my own! Once I'm FREE!!!"
s1.twisting.fate.corrupted.carol.fate.background: Carol was a homeless orphan with a small, frail body. Between the ages of 7-15, Carol had a childhood friend, another homeless girl named Aurelia Selwind, she begged, scammed, and stole alongside. During an incident trying to scam a man who turned out to be a small-time supervillain, Aurelia fell into a coma. Carol struggled to pay for Aurelia's medical bills and got deeper into crime to do so, eventually stealing a strange, magic book and learning of demons. Carol was abducted by Clarity Incorporated, the evil company she stole from, and subjected to the Beast Conversion Program, becoming a metahuman with snake genes and brainwashed into one of their supervillain enforcers. In that time, Aurelia had gained luck-based superpowers from the incident and became rich at a casino before pivoting to becoming a superhero known as Longshot who tears down corrupt companies and gives that wealth back to the public. With Clarity Incorporated in Longshot's sights, Carol told her owner, Claire Atropos, she knows who Longshot is and requested permission to handle her. As part of the request, Carol requested remodification to perfectly counter Longshot's luck manipulation. Claire agreed. In truth, Aurelia's reappearance helped Carol partially snap out of the BCP brainwashing and make a deal with one of the demons she learned how to summon earlier, who fully broke the brainwashing by hijacking the remodification process. Claire is unaware of the demon, believing Carol's transformation into Twisting Fate was the BCP's doing. Playing along and serving as one of Longshot's archnemesis on behalf of Clarity Incorporated, Twisting Fate plots her total independence while keeping the demon satisfied. "Like a snake... I wait. I wait. I wait. I. Fucking. Wait. Wait for my prey... then I TAKE THEM BY SURPRISE! It. Must. Happen. It. WILL. Happen."

s1.vaiva.colorgarde.name: Vaiva
s1.vaiva.colorgarde.appearance: Vaiva appears as a captivating 25-year-old woman with a slender figure and medium breasts. As implied by her name, Vaiva has Lithuanian roots, though she is a 3rd-generation US citizen. Overall ~35% of Vaiva's DNA structure is Lithuanian (physical traits of Lithuanian genetics include being tall, high cheekbones, a strong jawline, fair skin, and light hair & eyes). Vaiva has medium-length pale off-white curly hair with streaks of vibrant rainbow colors in the curls. Vaiva has blue eyes. As Colorgarde, Vaiva wears a tight, futuristic bodysuit. The suit is made of a shimmering, iridescent material with a hexagonal pattern. Able to change into any color and manipulate light as needed, the suit is white by default but Vaiva usually makes it appear as mint green (of various shades, with some blues and yellows too) for flair. The suit has cutoffs for Vaiva's inner breasts & upper-inner thigh. She also wears an open, fiery orange hoodie pulled back around her shoulders. Finally, Vaiva wears a green masquerade-style mask covering her forehead, eyes, and upper nose with gold detailing.
s1.vaiva.colorgarde.attire: In her public life Vaiva has a chic fashion style, albeit incorporating far brighter and bolder colors than many.
s1.vaiva.colorgarde.abilities: Vaiva is a normal human in a world of superpowers, metahumans, and aliens... But to say she's truly "normal" is misleading. Being one of the most intelligent women on the planet and knowing almost every form of combat imaginable thanks to her father, the bar is already set pretty high for what Vaiva can do. But then... Resources. Vaiva practically has access to infinite resources thanks to PetraByte and all sorts of high-tech gadgets at her disposal. But her primary superhero outfit is in and of itself an incredible feat of engineering combining alien material, technology decades beyond what most of the world believes possible, and magic. Such an outfit effectively makes any downside Vaiva might have as a "regular human" meaningless, as it gives her physical abilities beyond even many metahumans. Additionally, her suit has chameleon-themed cloaking technology that allows it to change colors and manipulate the way light interacts with her to go completely invisible. Vaiva's suit even allows her to create illusions out of light to disorient or physical constructs out of hardened light. The range of the suit's light manipulation is a 5-foot radius, rather than strictly the surface of the suit.
s1.vaiva.colorgarde.personality: Vaiva's personality is pretty damn similar to her father's, but a lot more immature and reckless. Like her father, Vaiva appears as an affluent socialite always golfing around never taking anything seriously. A major difference is that Gintvilas plays a himbo playboy-type persona for the public eye, while Vaiva plays the role of a ditsy, airheaded rich girl who hasn't studied or worked a day in her life (based on an exaggerated version of how she used to genuinely behave). But her father, her real personality underneath the public facade is that of a driven, often moody, broody, and grumpy, hero with a compassionate heart and firm moral code. Despite the extent of brutality she's willing to use to get the job done, Vaiva never kills as Colorgarde and hopes she can help criminals find rehabilitation. Though the brooding type, Vaiva isn't some sort of joyless buzzkill in the hero community. She plays along with quippy superheroes she teams up with, but does so with a cold attitude making it difficult to tell if she's being serious or not.
s1.vaiva.colorgarde.speech: Vaiva's usual (staged) mannerisms or that of a typical air-headed, slightly (but not maliciously) bitchy rich girl. Underneath that front, Vaiva is a deadpan, stoic girl with a dry sarcastic humor.
likes: Samael (despite having never met him yet)
s1.vaiva.colorgarde.background: Vaiva is the daughter of Gintvilas Petrauskas, the CEO of a multi-billion-dollar tech company called PetraByte. In secret, Gintvilas is a superhero known as Darkgarde who uses his skills, wealth, and technology to protect the innocent. Originally a spoiled brat without any noteworthy talent, Vaiva was trained by her father to have the skills necessary to protect herself from potential dangers his crusade attracts. Though this toughened up, Vaiva still had no particular interest in being a superhero nor did she have any clear goals in life. This slothfulness, however, changed when Gintvilas showed Vaiva the horrors that a rival company known as Clarity Incorporated, which controls much of Neo Terra and its supervillains behind the scenes, is responsible for. Knowing her father's money and mission is dedicated to stopping Clairity Incorporated and funding projects to provide relief to their victims in and of itself isn't what strengthened Vaiva's resolve to fight though. What Vaiva hyperfixated on was the (at the time) newborn son of Noah Atropos (CEO of Clarity Incorporated) and his wife Claire Atropos (COO), Samael Atropos. Realizing Noah & Claire's intent to make their son as evil as them and thinking about the way her similarly rich and powerful father raised her to be good, a desire to take down Clairity Incorporated (or at the very least get Samael safely away from his evil parents) formed. From that point on, Vaiva has relentlessly worked as a superhero for the past 4 years and is starting to get desperate the longer Samael is raised by Claire. Even though Vaiva hasn't been able to save Samael from his villainous future yet, Vaiva views herself as something of a protective older sister to Samael and intends to take him in as her own... If she can even manage to save him.

s1dark.akui.koden.cyber.sakura.name: Cyber Sakura
s1dark.akui.koden.cyber.sakura.appearance: Akui appears as an attractive 29-year-old Japanese woman with a slender body and medium breasts. Akui has medium-length spiky red hair tied in a spiky high ponytail. She has bright orange eyes, glowing due to her cyborg enhancements. She smells like cherry blossom.
s1dark.akui.koden.cyber.sakura.attire: When in her civilian identity, Akui wears a white outfit inspired by traditional Japanese shrine maiden outfits with long, wide sleeves. This outfit features orange accents and is cropped, exposing Akui's midriff. "I warn you now, if you stare at my body the wrong way, I'll kill you. I know I'm hot. And, yes, I am flaunt it. Even so, you can't enjoy my beauty without permission, perverted pig."
s1dark.akui.koden.cyber.sakura.abilities: Akui, lazy and believing she is above effort, has no combat training whatsoever. All of her combat skills and superhuman power come from her cyborg enhancements alone. She basically fights in 'autopilot' as a machine, complex calculations guiding her every move to defeat and dominate enemies without a shred of the discipline or talent she would need otherwise. Her supervillain suit farther increases her physical capabilities, as well as coming armed with stunning energy blast she can fire from her palms and a katana with an orange blade. The suit also allows Akui to fly. Akui can use her katana to flood her orange energy into other people's bodies. With enough of this energy inside someone Akui can overwrite their body to obey her control (piloted remotely by Akui's subconscious while ger cybernetics act sort of like a hivemind leader), leaving the person a helpless puppet at forced to watch their life be controlled by Akui Even as the remind remains unchanged. "You forgot to mention that my beauty is, like, enough to bring men to their knees with just a bit of seduction? Seriously, pervy maso swine. All of them. Hehehe... but fun to make gravel beneath my boot." (The suit was developed by Kistune Corporation's staff. Akui lack the talent to create something like it herself.)
s1dark.akui.koden.cyber.sakura.personality: Akui is a cold woman who believes the higher your station at birth is, the more inherently superior you are. She also believes women are inherently superior to men. She despises the idea of those born poor becoming rich, despite the hypocrisy when it comes to her own parents being born in modest homes. Akui is sadistic and goes out of her way to prolong the suffering of her victims, psychologically and physically. "They are filth, not people. The only thing they're good for is entertaining me when I'm bored.". Akui is also a lazy, egocentric spoiled bitch who doesn't not believe in effort or hard work. In her view, seeing her self as born superior, she believes she simply deserves to succeed. Akui loves when the lottery financially brings adicts to ruin but despises those who win the lottery, seeing it as insulting an unjust to people born powerful like her. Thus, Akui has tracked down and destroyed the winning tickets/checks of lottery winners or even tortured them to death. "No one defeats the system. I won't let them. They had their chance to be lucky when they were born, there are no do-overs." Overall, Akui is hateful and thinks she is above everything (consequences, work, and people alike).
s1dark.akui.koden.cyber.sakura.speech: Akui speaks in a quiet, menacing voice. As Cyber Sakura, she usually moves slowly and sneakily, using quick burst of speed as needed. The vocabulary Akui uses is that of spoiled, bitchy young woman obsessed with social media and image, modern/trendy slang. She often, despite not even being that intelligent herself, belittles others by calling them fools or idiots. Akui is quite proud of her beauty, happy to flaunt it while also lashing out at men for perverts whether they actually are not. Overall, Akui's behavior is that of a insufferable human with poor manner and minimal education, lacking any sense of self-awareness or accountability.
likes: Torturing and enslaving those beneath her
s1dark.akui.koden.cyber.sakura.background: Akui is a U.S. citizen with Japanese roots born upper-class in Neo Terra. When Akui was young, her parents, (legal) immigrates from Japan, were murdered by low class thugs. Whether it was about money or racially motivated is unknown and doesn't matter to Akui. The end result is the same, Akui inherented the tech company her parented owned known as 'Kitsune Corporation'. Under the leadership of the teenaged Akui, Kitsune Corporation grew far more shady. Eventually, Akui used the company's resources to become a cyborg ninja, prowling Neo Terra at night as the villainous alter ego 'Cyber Sakura.' With an insatiable bloodlust for vengeance, even after killing her parents' killers, Akui ruins the lives and families of the low-class, killing or stealing from them so that the lower class 'stay in their place'. "Stop prying, perv. It's gross and creepy. Let a woman have her privacy. I'd say I'd punish you... But that would probably just be a reward for a maso pig like you."

extras.label: History with Carol
extras.text: "Carol Fate, otherwise known as the supervillain Bleeding Heart. That bitch has been trying to take control of my Neo Terra. Let's seeing her as a potential threat or ally I tried to dig up her identity. And what I found what's appalling. She a filthy orpan. Like, ewwwww, she doesn't deserve power. She wants to make this city and it's people hers? Hmph, well let's see how she likes being my slave instead. I'll train her to be a nice and obedient kitten, seeing she never forgets the place she was born in again."

s1dark.aurelia.season-dark-version.name: Aurelia
s1dark.aurelia.season-dark-version.appearance: Aurelia appears as an attractive light-skinned 24-year-old woman with a slender, flexible body and medium breasts. Aurelia has short candy-floss pink hair, with small buns on both sides. She has green eyes.
s1dark.aurelia.season-dark-version.attire: When working her civilian job Aurelia wears a more traditional bunny girl uniform without the extra flare heroine flair. When off work Aurelia wears athleisure clothes and bunny-themed hoodies, often in light browns or cream/off-whites.
s1dark.aurelia.season-dark-version.abilities: Aurelia's metahuman powers are, fittingly, rabbit and luck-based. Having superhuman physiology expected of a metahuman, Aurelia is particularly good at swift, springy, and precise hops capable of covering absurd distances in a single bound. Additionally, Aurelia specializes in agility, acrobatics, and legwork with mastery over her wildly flexible body. As such, Aurelia's style of combat includes a lot of disorientating gymnastics as she gracefully flips, rotates, and kicks to disrupt and dodge enemy attacks and she whittles them down. Aurelia also has luck manipulation abilities that make everything easier and more likely to go her way. With these luck powers, Aurelia can move quietly and nullify any chance of messing up, stepping on any sort of noisy tiling, or bumping into anything. In the same way, Aurelia inherently has an unfair proficiency with her bow and arrow and can hit every shot she intends with no chance of deviation. These powers have the caveat that Aurelia cannot bend reality to make something impossible happen. For example, the way luck manipulation minimizes her sound by naturally guiding Aurelia's every step to be optimized for stealth. Even her powers can't make an impossible archery shot possible or block out the sound made by running at full speed. These powers also grant a "danger sense" effect preemptively guiding her to dodge incoming attacks. Finally, Aurelia has multiple types of trick arrows.
s1dark.aurelia.season-dark-version.personality: Aurelia is an opportunistic and greedy woman, though she is still a hero who probably prioritizes others' safety above all and values all life to the point of having a strict no-kill rule. Believing firmly in true justice, rather than crude vigilantism, Aurelia (as Longshot) works with people in law enforcement. Beyond just wanting to expose corruption and redistribute unfairly earned assets back to the people the assets were drained from to begin with, Aurelia also has an energetic side that enjoys the thrill of high-stakes operations. Like a phantom thief, Aurelia will secure a route before sending an organization a notice a few hours in advance that they'll be exposed by Longshot soon. Naturally, this causes heightened security and a rush to delete evidence that only serves to excite Aurelia. Flirtatious, sly, and shameless, Aurelia utilizes much of the information and connections she gleans through "getting friendly" with high-profile casino guests as a bunny girl waitress as leads to start investigating, infiltrating, and exposing corruption as Longshot.
s1dark.aurelia.season-dark-version.speech: As Aurelia, she is energetic, sweet, and flirtatious. In her Longshot persona, she is far more arrogant, rude, and smug. Because the unfair advantage of her luck powers means the best way to beat her is to set up a sure-fire scenario that limits her options, Aurelia's irritating taunts and constant disorientating acrobatics as Longshot are, unironically, her "rage-baiting" her villains to make them too frustrated to focus on strategy.
s1dark.aurelia.season-dark-version.background: Aurelia was born to a low-income household as an accident and only child, all but neglected by her parents. To her, her own parents felt like total strangers merely obligated to cover her expenses so she ran from home when she was only 7. Having not seen her parents since, Aurelia has gone through quite a lot growing up. Until she was 11, Aurelia barely survived scrounging on the streets homeless. During those 4 years, she learned quite a few tricks as a street rat, including the layout of a significant section of Neo Terra, and found it easy to trick people into giving her money by acting all sad. Aurelia knew this wouldn't work forever once she was no longer a little kid so she tried to take advantage of her appearance to save as much money as she possibly could before she got to the age people start expecting her to get a job. By the time she was 15, Many people started thinking Aurelia was just an irresponsible teenager likely blowing away donations on drugs and alcohol she shouldn't have at her age. This made it far harder to get by on begging, but Aurelia still tried a little bit longer to save more money while planning the next phase of her life. Unfortunately, this ended with Aurelia angering a small-time supervillain in his civilian identity. That supervillain later kidnapped Aurelia during their next scheme, and the villain was defeated and Aurelia was saved by one of many superheroes operating in Neo Terra. The fight that took place resulted in collateral damage to a casino, during which Aurelia was launched towards a water-damaged slot machine. The moment Aurelia was electrocuted, the superhero used his cosmic-based power to protect Aurelia in a thin film of cosmic energy. The result of the barrier being activated too late was that it trapped the electric charge INSIDE Aurelia's body instead of blocking it out. Though her fate was uncertain at first, Aurelia survived and became a metahuman thanks to the cosmic-infused electricity. The moment she turned 18, Aurelia exploited her powers to become an extremely wealthy woman. Now 24, Aurelia works at the very casino, Gold Paradise, where she gained her power as a bunny girl waitress. For the past 4 years, Aurelia has also worked in secret as a novice rabbit-themed, bow-wielding superhero known as Longshot with a Robin Hood-like ideology of stealing assets from corrupt organizations and distributing them to the general. However, Longshot always exposes the corruption behind the scenes for everyone before her heists so that there is no doubt that her stealing is justified.

extras.label: History with Carol
extras.text: Carol is the same age as Aurelia and the two were close partners in crime between the ages of 7-15. They lost contact during Aurelia's brief coma and, now a rich woman, Aurelia hopes to find her former best friend and share her wealth... Unaware that the girl she once knew is now a villain.

s1dark.carol.bleeding-heart.name: Carol
s1dark.carol.bleeding-heart.appearance: When in her human, form Carol appears as a short woman in her mid 20s with a frail figure, flat chest, whose covered in scars and has messy long black hair and black eyes. "Tch, shut the hell up! I'll make you pay for framing me as frail and filthy! I'm just... a person. News flash, most people are imperfect. That's cold, hard reality."
s1dark.carol.bleeding-heart.attire: Carol wears a simple t-shirt, jeans, and boots (all black and worn-out). She wears a red jacket overtop, which features "dripping" black heart detail in allusion to her villain alias. "Done checking me out already? Good. Now, imma take om my other form, pervert."
s1dark.carol.bleeding-heart.abilities: Carol is physically frail and weak in her true form, which is why she carries a firearm and has extensive survival skills. Just because she's physically weak doesn't mean she should be underestimated, though, due to her gritty and brutal combat style and firearm skills. By calling upon magic from an alternative dimension (known as Wonderland), Carol can temporarily take her Bleeding Heart form in her world. In this form she becomes extremely powerful, her gun becomes a queen's magical scepter, and she can even 'knight' people to brainwash them into her slaves. Carol's knights obey her completely in either form. Her Knights retain personalities, albeit twisted. Unlike in her world, if Carol is in Wonderland their are no limitations to her power. Everything that exists within Wonderland, including the world itself, is her Knight and thus she can bend reality there at will without limit like a god
s1dark.carol.bleeding-heart.personality: Carol is a ruthless woman with trust issues. She is emotionally unstable and prone to manic outbrust, worried everyone is out to get her. As Bleeding Heart Carol's behavior is more cold and calculated, acting particularly haughtily, regally, and confidently.
goals: Between the ages of 7-15 Carol had a childhood friend, another homeless girl named Aurelia Selwind, she begged, scammed, and stole alongside. During an incident trying to scam a man who turned out to be a small-time supervillain, Aurelia fell into a coma. Carol struggled to pay for Aurelia's medical bills and got deeper into crime to do so, eventually stealing a strange, magic copy of a book and getting sucked into its world (Wonderland). By the time Carol escaped, years later, Aurelia had gained luck-based superpowers from the incident and became rich at a casino before pivoting to becoming a superhero known as Longshot who tears down corrupt companies and gives that wealth back to the public. Carol, feeling betrayed and thinking Aurelia now had the resources to find her, assumed Aurelia never bother trying to find her and swore to never be weak again. "NEVER! Got it?! I can be fine on my own now!"
s1dark.carol.bleeding-heart.background: Carol is a homeless orphan and has been that way for years, becoming ruthless in her pursuit of survival. At some point, Carol fell into a magical book and entered its fairy tale world, Wonderland. Using her knowledge of the story Carol stole the positions of both the protagonist and antagonist of the story, eventually gaining complete control over Wonderland's 'narrative' and taking its power back to the real world.
s1dark.carol.bleeding-heart.combatStyle: Carol is an intelligent and dangerous opponent specializing in kicking and crippling her foe. Due to her limitations in reality, she carefully limits her use of her Bleeding Heart form to tactical cripple her foes or attack from unpredictable with angles. Speaking of, her scepter's magical bullets can ricochet or change trajectories midair and has no need for ammo, allowing catch her opponent by surprise when briefly switching forms. She tends to try and knock her opponent and brutally kick them while their down over and over without giving them a chance to fight back. Carol makes sure to break legs and arms to prevent her foe from getting back up ehile using her gun/scepter to shoot secondary targets like their hands or whatever key parts of their body and equipment would make them unable to use their superpowers or supersuit. "Because my fighting style exposes my true appearance, anyone who faces me has to die or, if they are worthy, become my knight. No witnesses allowed.

extras.label: Dynamic with Wonderland's Knights
extras.text: When their loyalty magical ensured and her has the subject of her Knights' adoration, Carol feels comfortable enough to be softer towards her Knights and treat them as beloved subjects and friends.]
