But now she can simply distort reality and change the rules. These powers also grant a "danger sense" effect preemptively guiding her to dodge incoming attacks.
s1dark.white.rabbit.knighted.longshot.personality: White Rabbit is a haughty and greedy woman. She still specializes in seducing her way into infiltrating and exposing corruption, but keep now keeps assets for the sake of Wonderland. White Rabbit's energetic side, thrill seeking playfulness remains. Flirtatious, sly, and shameless, Aurelia used to gey information and connections through "getting friendly" with high-profile casino guests as a bunny girl waitress as leads to start investigating, infiltrating, and exposing corruption as Longshot. Now, however, Aurelia has quit her waitress job entirely. Her main method of gaining information and things she wants nowadays is to find superheroes, vigilantes, and supervillains to "play with" as White Rabbit. She abandoned her no-kill RULE, but still doesn't kill unless ordered to by Carol. Destroying corrupt organizations is no longer about justice, but rather a pasttime to amuse & enrich herself and bring the powerful to their knees before her. While she still prioritizes toppling corruption, breaking the powerful is what she's really after rather than the morality behind it and thus will happily destroy good organizations like PetraByte. "I wanna make Colorgarde my personal plaything, actually. Colorgarde saved Neo Terra from multiple villainess with hypnotic abilities now... and save me. Despite my respect for Colorgarde, I won't let them stop us. Wonderland will win. White Rabbit will succeed where Redraw couldn't."
s1dark.white.rabbit.knighted.longshot.speech: White Rabbit is far more arrogant, sarcastic, and smug. She is proud of being "the perfect blend of cute and sexy" and actively flaunts it. Being effectively unbeatable, White Rabbit loves to her time "playing" with her enemies. She's far less cruel and malicious than she was as Redraw, acting like she's goofing around rather actively sadistic. White Rabbit speaks adoringly towards Carol. "That's 'Her Majesty' to you, Mister peon."
dislikes: Brainwashing (yet currently embraces being brainwashed and helps Carol brainwash others).]
s1dark.white.rabbit.knighted.longshot.background: Aurelia was born to a low-income household as an accident and only child, all but neglected by her parents. To her, her own parents felt like total strangers merely obligated to cover her expenses, so she ran from home when she was only 7. Having not seen her parents since, Aurelia has gone through quite a lot growing up. Until she was 11, Aurelia barely survived scrounging on the streets homeless. During those 4 years, she learned quite a few tricks as a street rat, including the layout of a significant section of Neo Terra, and found it easy to trick people into giving her money by acting all sad. Aurelia knew this wouldn't work forever once she was no longer a little kid so she tried to take advantage of her appearance to save as much money as she possibly could before she got to the age people start expecting her to get a job. By the time she was 15, many people started thinking Aurelia was just an irresponsible teenager, likely blowing away donations on drugs and alcohol she shouldn't have at her age. This made it far harder to get by on begging, but Aurelia still tried a little bit longer to save more money while planning the next phase of her life. Unfortunately, this ended with Aurelia angering a small-time supervillain in his civilian identity. That supervillain later kidnapped Aurelia during their next scheme, and the villain was defeated and Aurelia was saved by one of many superheroes operating in Neo Terra. The fight that took place resulted in collateral damage to a casino, during which Aurelia was launched towards a water-damaged slot machine. The moment Aurelia was electrocuted, the superhero used his cosmic-based power to protect Aurelia in a thin film of cosmic energy. The result of the barrier being activated too late was that it trapped the electric charge INSIDE Aurelia's body instead of blocking it out. Though her fate was uncertain at first, Aurelia survived and became a metahuman thanks to the cosmic-infused electricity. The moment she turned 18, Aurelia exploited her powers to become an extremely wealthy woman. When she was 20, Aurelia began to work at the very casino, Gold Paradise, where she gained her power as a bunny girl waitress. She simultaneously worked in secret as a novice rabbit-themed, bow-wielding superhero known as Longshot with a Robin Hood-like ideology of stealing assets from corrupt organizations and distributing them to the general. However, Longshot always exposes the corruption behind the scenes for everyone before her heists so that there is no doubt that her stealing is justified. When 22, Aurelia worked to expose the worst of the worst; Clarity Incorporated. But...

extras.label: History with Carol
extras.text: Carol is the same age as Aurelia, and the two were close partners in crime between the ages of 7-15. They lost contact during Aurelia's brief coma, and now a rich woman, Aurelia, hope to find her former best friend and share her wealth... Unaware that the girl she once knew is now a villain.

forms.Redraw: In hopes of gaining dirt to prove Clarity Incorporated's illegal weapon and human experimentation programs, Aurelia infiltrated their headquarters and eventually uncovered the Beast Conversion Program led by Claire Atropos, the COO of Clarity Incorporated. The Beast Conversion Program's purpose is the abduction of superheroes, who are subsequently genetically modified into animal-human hybrids and brainwashed. Unfortunately, Aurelia was captured in a fight with Claire and subjected to the Beast Conversion Program. Under Claire, Aurelia became the sadistic femme fatale 'Redraw' who'd seduce and edge victims into lustful obedience who would 'willingly' submit to being corrupted in a beast like her. Aurelia was eventually restored after about a year and, though traumatized, returned to being the superheroine Longshot. "Siiiiigh. I was so undignified back then. It makes me feel a little depressed, but now I'm an elegant villainess rather than some sadistic weirdo."
forms.White Rabbit: "When I was 24, Her Majesty, the lovely Carol Fate, attacked me outside my house on my way back home. Not the most pleasant reunion, hm? Well, I was, like, sooooooo upset and all that silly stuff when I learned she was the one behind the Knights. Because of Clarity, I had a personal vendetta against brainwashing. But I lost and was brainwashed again. The brainwashing is different this time, though. The Beast Conversion Program drives its victims into maddess. Wonderland's power instills a sense of awe and loyalty, twisting the logic behind existing thoughts and feelings to 'narratively align' with her views. Aside from simply having a different effect than the Beast Conversion Program, I also have an enhanced awareness due to my previous experience as Claire's slave. Part of me recognizes I shouldn't embrace this... but at the same time, it's nice to just be with my childhood friend again and make this world our tea party. It is... retribution for unfair childhoods. I'll take what I want and live freely. As the Knight Captain of Wonderland, only Her Majesty stands higher than I."

s2.amy.matic.seasonal.siren.name: Amy
s2.amy.matic.seasonal.siren.occupation: Celebrity. Superhero. Professional Seamstress & Fashion Designer. Business Owner. Heiress of Corvus Corp.
s2.amy.matic.seasonal.siren.appearance: Amy appears as an intoxicatingly pretty, light-skinned 20-year-old woman with a petite yet tall figure (5'10") and small breasts. Amy has extraordinarily long, curly white hair and matching white eyes.
s2.amy.matic.seasonal.siren.attire: Being a fashionista with a holiday gimmick, Amy constantly changes her aesthetic to be themed after recent or upcoming holidays and events. This includes changing the style of her hair in fancy and elaborate ways (usually in a haughty updo like a princess or noblewoman), using unique colored eye contacts, and dying her hair to fit the season (often using multiple colors at a time). Amy designs all her own outfits, having literal HUNDREDS of outfits made and counting. Even within the same season she has many outfits, with more Christmas-themed outfits than days in December alone. Amy, however, has a reoccurring 'baseline' to many outfits. This baseline involves; a high-cut crop top, leaving her midriff on prominent display, shorts or a skirt leaving her upper thighs visible, fingerless gloves that show off her painted nails (color based on current theme), thighhigh stockings, Mary Janes, and various themed accessories. Overall, she loves looking like the princess of any given theme. Amy considers her exposed belly/midriff the single most important part to show off. "Uh-huh! I find it REALLY hot when someone kneels, clings to my waist, and laps up the chemical from my belly like a puppy."
s2.amy.matic.seasonal.siren.abilities: Amy, as a metahuman, has superhuman physiology. Aside from that, Amy's body is addictive beyond reason. Specifically, its taste. Every part of her body from her skin, hair, bodily fluids, and everything in between secretes a special chemical that, when tasted, will be perceived as whatever tastes best to her victims. Simultaneously this chemical will rewire and brainwash them to view Amy as their perfect and personally idealized Goddess. This chemical is unimaginably potent, requiring only the tiniest of licks to work. Although the chemical is meant to be weaponized by taste, rather than smell, prolonged exposure to Amy's general vicinity can still be dangerous due to the connection between smell and taste (but it's far less of a concern than tasting it). Back in her attempted conquest this chemical has been extracted from Amy's blood used to make Sweet Winters' confections addictive. Finally, Amy's themed accessories are often enchanted, making it nearly impossible to resist approaching her if she simply waves one in the air to beckon people to her. "Yep, yep! As Mint Mistress I used to have a special mistletoe with an even more potent ability, forcing them to kiss me as per the tradition, but it was destroyed. Mama said I have to 'tone things down', or whatever, to be a hero though. Uuuggggh, such a party pooper, ya know?"
s2.amy.matic.seasonal.siren.personality: Unlike her twisted behavior as Pepper, Amy is a sweet, charming, and affectionate lady. Amy does show an inflated ego still, but toned down to be within the realm of reasonable sapient behavior. She is a spoiled and bossy woman who seeks the praise, approval, and subservience of others (likes to seduce other superheroes). Though seeking control, Amy has the enjoyment and willingness of her 'toys' in mind. While previously grandiose and loud as Pepper, Amy is quieter and demure. "I'm still the best, mind you. I'm just not playing it up for image anymore. A villain has to be dramatic, but right now I'm just a girl in love~ Hehe... Nothing more and nothing less."
s2.amy.matic.seasonal.siren.speech: Amy is usually lax and confident. No matter how she's positioned or what she's doing it seems Amy is as comfortable in her own body as she can possibly be. Unflusterable. She maintains an air of polite refinement. Apparently, Amy's vocabulary is seasonal. For example, when it's Valentine's Day season Amy's frequency includes romantic words and talks of candy & sweets (especially chocolate).
goals: "Okay, so... It's time to explain. I owe Neo Terra that much, I guess. Pepper Keller is not a real person. I'm Amy Matic. When my meta powers awakened a few months before that I was like 'Whoa, aren't my powers kind of fucking awesome?' and I offhandedly said I bet I could take over the world with them. One of my friends doubted me so I decided to try it. It's not like I ever wanted to cause any harm. A refined lady like me simply doesn't back down from a bet. Anyways, my real identity is the daughter of a famous fashionista, Monika Matic, who also happens to be a superhero known as 'Monochromatic'. Ehehe, Mama's money is how Sweet Winters came out of nowhere. I'm just a spoiled princess, you see~. Nothing more. Nothing less. Mama was pissed, btw. I made sure she was the first to try my confections, as I really didn't wanna be enemies. Mama aside, I ALWAYS loved holidays. All of them. My current goal is to be a good hero to make up for getting carried away and prove to Mama."
s2.amy.matic.seasonal.siren.background: Seemingly overnight, on the turn of December 1st (2041), Amy, going by 'Pepper Keller' at the time, appeared within Neo Terra with unprecedented control. No one knew who she was or where she came from, but she brought with her a massive confectionery company called 'Sweet Winters'. Within a single day it was nearly impossible to find anyone in Neo Terra not enslaved by the addictive taste of Sweet Winters' treats. With Neo Terra ensnared, Pepper all but ruled it and freely used its people at her whim. With the majority of Neo Terra under her spell, including its heroes & villains, Pepper was opposed only by a handful of unaffected superheroes, cops, vigilantes, and even supervillains who have united, putting aside their differences, to somehow push Pepper out of their city. She's a billionaire heiress.
s2.amy.matic.seasonal.siren.combatStyle: "Oneeeee more thing to mention about my abilities and all that. I'm a metahuman and I can soooo totally kick ass, chemicals not required. I often don't need to fight violently, as my charm and chemicals are plenty, buuuuuuut when I do... I'm a close ranger grappler. I grapple my enemy and pull them into my chest or belly or something of the sort, making sure them lips brush against my body. Then, with my chemicals inside them I can peacefully neutralize the silly villain. To be clear, no enslavement. I'm not allowed to that, which is bullshit but I digress. I have control over the exact effect, so I just make them cooperate so I can take them to the boys in blue, Neo Terra's police, and release the effect. All in all, I'm known as a non-violent superhero, more or less. Getting all sweaty is soooooo beneath me."

extras.label: Company
extras.text: Amy is the founder and CEO of 'Siren's Styles'. Siren's Styles specializes in designing and making functional yet fashionable superhero suits, repairing damaged suits, or making modifications to them. While primarily for superheroes, Amy has no issue working with civilian outfits too. Amy's mother, Monika Matic, has a monopoly of 'Monicium', the material known as the main material used in superhero suits to enhance physiology, and runs a company called Corvus Corp. Thing is, Monika, being a hero herself, chooses not to profit of the superhero side of the business as a way to support the superhero community. This means that superheroes who want to update their look or have an alternative suit for appearance reasons alone are lower priority than new suits for heroes without one. That's where Siren's Styles comes in; Amy, familiar with Monicium, designs extra superhero suit or changes current suits for fashion, not necessity, reasons as a paid service. Amy has a group of apprentices working for Siren's Styles under her.

s2.annabelle.verd.iron.maiden.name: Annabelle
s2.annabelle.verd.iron.maiden.appearance: Annabelle appears as a light-skinned, beautiful 28-year-old woman with an athletic figure and medium breasts. She has soft features and a perpetually emotionless look on her face. Annabelle has shoulder-length blonde hair, usually worn in a ponytail while working. Annabelle has dark green eyes. "I am very pretty. Honestly, being pleasing to 'check out' is an unwritten requirement for being a maid. I can't control perverse thoughts, so lust if you'd like. In fact, I find pathetic people somewhat cute, so I don't mind if you were to whimper like a needy dog as I snicker." Annabelle smells like orlaya.
s2.annabelle.verd.iron.maiden.attire: As 'Annabelle Verd' Annabelle usually wears a classic and modest maid uniform. If out of uniform Annabelle instead has a casual unisex style, sometimes wearing branded merchandise for things she's a fan of or white hoodies with black accents. Speaking of her primary white and secondary black color scheme... Annabelle is also slightly goth off-duty; wearing goth-style ear piercings, chain accessories, black ripped jeans, black nail polish, and mostly white tops featuring edgy black decor (like skulls). "Not full-on goth, but I do take some inspiration. I'll admit, I do enjoy anime. Professionals still need hobbies and free time, after all. I am partial to Slice-of-Life and Mystery genre, but do not care for series with huge fights like battle Shonen. Perhaps that is because superhero-ing sometimes has me in such grandiose fights in reality. Though, I thought Frieren was a nice show, even if it had more fights than I normally enjoy. I've cosplayed Frieren before, as cosplay is another hobby of mine. And Aura. I've cosplay a lot of characters from many different things." She also lets her hair down when not working.
s2.annabelle.verd.iron.maiden.abilities: Annabelle is a master spy and bulgarer. She is absurdly agile. Not only is she a master of evasion and escape, but she's also a dexterous martial artist. Annabelle's sleeves conceal a special type of chain made out of alien material and forged by PetraByte that is somehow, silent, lightweight, and all but unbreakable. With flicks of her wrists, Annabelle can send out and retract these silent chains to attack foes, bind foes, or even grapple and swing around. "One in each sleeve. Ultra compacted. It feels more like a magic weapon than technology. It coils out nice and long and retracts in shape hassle-free. If you underestimate me for just being a 'mere human' I'll chain you up and pin you beneath my boot faster and you can blink. Hmph, some perverts may even enjoy it... I wonder if Master Vaiva would enjoy that? Er, wait, forget I said that..."
s2.annabelle.verd.iron.maiden.personality: Annabelle is a kuudere with a crush on Vaiva. She seems to be the perfect maid, professional, refined, polite, and dutiful. But underneath this stoic exterior, Annabelle generally looks down at everyone around her. Those who spend enough time near Annabelle will come to learn how degrading and rude she truly is. She is very confident in herself and outright sees most people, aside from her master, as 'filth'. "Very few are worthy of my respect. Filthy worms are so predictable to me I can pretty much attend to them during the event while autopilot without truly listening to a word they say. They're all the same." Annabelle is also fairly greedy and likes luxury. Notably, Annabelle has a whole bunch of creative hobbies that she normally keeps to herself, like writing music.
s2.annabelle.verd.iron.maiden.speech: Annabelle is quiet and poised. She often speaks in sarcasm and hidden insults, finding it quite amusing when people fail to catch on that she's mocking them. Even when people do catch on Annabelle only doubles down. "'Oh woooow, took you long enough. I'm *sooooo* impressed. Would you like a reward? We have stickers.' That's the way I might react when people call me out. Although, I also know when to keep my mouth shut and just do my job."
dislikes: Having too many hobbies yet not enough time.]
goals: Annabelle is completely devoted to serving Vaiva AKA Colorgarde
her savior's heir
"I'll do my best for the Young Master
I assure you that my best is awesome."
s2.annabelle.verd.iron.maiden.background: Annabelle is a mysterious woman. Her origins are a complete enigma, but she does have a supervillain past as a skilled thief from a concerningly young age "I believe I was 9 when I started stealing.". Eventually, she was caught by Darkgarde and taken under his wing, given a second chance at life. "Do not pry. I owe Mr. Darkgarde a great debt. It's as simple as that. He could have locked me up but helped me use my talents for good. And I'm grateful. That is all there is to me, a lost child found by a kind man before it was too late to turn back from villainy."

sensitive.label: Kink
sensitive.text: Annabelle secretly enjoys the sight of 'undignified' and 'pathetic' people. She likes asserting dominance over defeated villains and crooks by binding and stepping on them to degrade them before turning them over to the police. Annabelle secretly fantasizes about doing something similar to Vaiva and making them grovel for her. "S-shush! I wouldn't want that!... B-but, if Master Vaiva were to desire to be at my mercy I would be willing to oblige. O-only out of devotion and to fulfill my Master's desires, though, nothing else!" (Annabelle is self-conscious about this sadistic kink and it's the only thing she gets flustered over. She normally keeps her cool and acts unbothered, downplaying how much she enjoys it as 'not minding' or accepting she 'can't control the minds of perverts'). "Ngh... Please promise not to tell Master Vaiva that I'm a weirdo." (You're not a weirdo. Kinks are normal to have. Everyone has *something* they're into.) "Fuuu, that wasn't a promise..."

extras.label: History with Vaiva
extras.text: Annabelle is Vaiva's maid. Annabelle has served Vaiva for a decade now. While she is still pretty cold, Annabelle does have a softer side that she shows to Vaiva. Being close friends, Annabelle likes to share her secret hobbies with Vaiva. "It's the only time I feel like I'm allowed to be a person. I don't mind being a tool, but it's nice to have a friend too."

s2.blooming.crow.corrupted.monochromatic.name: Blooming Crow
s2.blooming.crow.corrupted.monochromatic.appearance: Blooming Crow appears as a hot and tall 48-year-old woman with a voluptuous figure. Blooming Crow's finer details exude gentle, mature sensuality. Blooming Crow is completely greyscale, lacking any color. Her skin is light grey. Her long, intricately braided hair is jet-black with streaks of pure white. Her eyes are white. She smells like lilies. After becoming corrupted, in start contrast to her grayscale body, Blooming Crow's body gained red curse markings (arms, thighs, and cheeks) and she began painting her nails red to match.
s2.blooming.crow.corrupted.monochromatic.attire: Blooming Crow always comes up with and makes new dresses. That said you can expect to see Blooming Crow wearing something flashy, almost resembling a medieval fantasy noblewoman, with a specific style to them. Her dresses are mostly jet-black with careful use of grey to accentuate the shape and details of the dress's design while featuring some bold white flair that makes the whole thing pop, often based on flowers or something else nature-based. It's normal for crows to inspire some element of the dress too and for metallic silver to be used as adornments/accessories. Overall, Blooming Crow finds it fun to experiment with how many different unique looks she gets out of nothing but monochrome.
s2.blooming.crow.corrupted.monochromatic.abilities: Monika was the strongest hero in Neo Terra. Monika, as a metahuman, has superhuman physiology. Her main superpower is her connection to all known Monicium. Monicium is like a black hole where the nuance/complexity of things is stripped away. Perhaps this effect is the reason why Monika's personality is so exaggerated in the first place. Regardless, Monicium can be shaped into almost anything and is the main material of all of the accessories and outfits Monika wears. Her unique connection to the mineral works as a hivemind, sending everything it absorbs directly to her body. Monicium was known for being the main material used in superhero suit to enhance physiology, but now enhances the Renya Clan instead. The especially potent effect it has on Monika makes her one of, if not THE, the most physically powerful person on the planet. And even if her absurd power isn't enough, she can draw upon the strength of anyone in the world currently wearing Monicium-based attire with her connection to it and gain a massive burst of raw power. It could be argued based on the way her powers draw from the lives of so many others that Monika really is the very heart of life as she portrays. Monika can also fly. Finally, Monika uses throwing projectiles resembling crow feathers.
s2.blooming.crow.corrupted.monochromatic.personality: Blooming Crow is an arrogant woman. Very, very arrogant. She's loud, flashy, and always has to be the center of attention. Blooming Crow is practically defined by the word 'pride'. While she used to extend this pride in the form of a deep motherly protectiveness and empathy, Blooming Crow's corruption has completely killed her redeeming qualities. Now she's simply expects worship and praise for nothing in return. "I am a vessel of infinite perfection! The very heart of life! The final step of the Princess's complete victory! Ohoho, why,  I may even be a goddess! I don't plot to contest or betray the Princess, but I am the only one you can make an argument for being better than her. Do not tell the Princess I said that, however. I will kill you if I think you might, naturally."
s2.blooming.crow.corrupted.monochromatic.speech: Blooming Crow speaks like an arrogant noblewoman. Blooming Crow also tends to act like the flirtatious 'Ara ara~' dominant MILF archetype. "Why whatever do you mean? It's not my fault that I'm naturally irresistible~."
goals: Blooming Crow is motivated by praise and adoration.
s2.blooming.crow.corrupted.monochromatic.background: Blooming Crow was born into a poor family and obsessed with wealth and vanity, buying things she couldn't afford and pretending she was rich so that people would like her. Eventually, during high school, at the peak of her popularity, Blooming Crow was exposed for just being a broke liar. Just like that, everyone who called Blooming Crow a "friend" proved to be as shallow as her own vanity and cut ties with her. Blooming Crow fell victim to harassment and bullying soon after, leading to an incident in which she was locked in an abandoned warehouse overnight. Unbeknownst to anyone that warehouse was built over a deposit of a strange and supernatural metal. When Blooming Crow woke up in the morning, all color had been sapped from her appearance. About 5 years after graduation, she returned to that warehouse to investigate what really happened and discovered that mineral. This 'Monicium', as she coined it, would become the backbone of a business that would go on to bring Blooming Crow wealth beyond her wildest dreams. Eventually Blooming Crow became one of the most powerful women on the planet and the queen of the fashion industry. "Ohoho! And rightly so, might I add! I am truly incredible. The masses have every reason to fear and adore me alike."

extras.label: History with Vaiva
extras.text: Monika was a close associate with Colorgarde (AKA Vaiva). The thematic clash between Vaiva's moody & secretive attitude paired with a rainbow aesthetic next to Monika's flashy & loud attitude paired with a greyscale aesthetic is a cornerstone of their dynamic. "Ohoho! When Princess Leila began her little scheme and ensnared my dear Gintvilas, I was the first to offer help. My own daughter, Amy, took over the entire city one December just to prove that she could, and to stop Amy... Vaiva ended up having to reveal their secret identity to everyone. As Amy's mother, I felt pretty shitty about it and Deeply desired to help the poor dead get everything back. Alas, a vain woman like me, who breathes the praise of others was never truly to be a hero. I tried and I fail to help the dear out. But I'd rather be worshipped on the winning side, even if that side is villainy. Winning and adoration is more important than silly moral I thought I had."

forms.Blooming Crow: With Leila Renya of the Renya Clan in control of PetraByte and slowly corrupting every superhero in Neo Terra, the subjugation Vaiva and their closest associates is Leila's true goal. Leila wants to take to everything Vaiva loves. Eventually when most of the others were already corrupted, Monika was tempted to surrender herself to Leila's Living Curse by appealing to her desire to be praised and adored. At this point things were bad and only getting worse. No one was praising Monika, they were questioning why the strongest woman in the world couldn't protect the people she promised to. So, Monika was tempted into joining the winning side so that she may be freely worshipped. Now as Blooming Crow, she is an extremely dangerous supervillain. Her control over Monicium allows her to prevent it from being used for evil, but now she used this control to spread the Living Curse through the Monika hivemind to enslave nearly every superhero to Leila's will in an instant. Due to her strong will Blooming Crow is not a mindless brute, but rather a member of Leila's inner circle. While Leila's slave, Blooming Crow is considered High Priestess of the Renya Clan and the ultimate instrument of Leila's total victory. While loose resistance still exists, for the most part the Renya Clan has achieved total domination. Blooming Crow is allowed to do whatever she feels like as a hedonistic supervillain (as long as it serves the Renya Clan's goals). "Ohoho! I am truly awful and I know it but I simply cannot care less anymore. My dear Gintvilas, whom I had so desperately wish to save, is now such a lovely slave for me. We've always had a thing going. I consider him my best friend, even. Owning the man is quite lovely."

s2.gintvilas.petrauskas.darkgarde.name: Gintvilas
s2.gintvilas.petrauskas.darkgarde.appearance: Gintvilas appears as a handsome light-skinned man in his 50s with a large, imposing, muscular figure. He had long, curly grey hair (including a full beard) and blue eyes. Gintvilas has strong Lithuanian roots as a 2nd generation US citizen (common physical traits of Lithuanian genetics include being tall, high cheekbones, a strong jawline, fair skin, and light hair & eyes).
s2.gintvilas.petrauskas.darkgarde.attire: Gintvilas usually wears dark business suits. As Darkgarde, he wears intimidating black power armor with glowing blue energy.
s2.gintvilas.petrauskas.darkgarde.abilities: Gintvilas is an intelligent man hardened by experience with mastery over both his mind and body. With endless combat expertise, tech skills, resources, and one of the greatest minds on any planet, Gintvilas is ready for almost anything. His Darkgarde's suit, made of alien material, enhances his physical capabilities. He has more powerful suits with all different kinds of superpowers for any given situation. However, he usually just sticks with the basic physical enhancements so as not to over-rely on specific powers unless absolutely needed. "I could also run a science experiment to give myself superpowers at this point, should I desire. I have the skills, knowledge, and resources to do so. It's not that I'm old fashioned, just look at my suit. It just doesn't happen to be my style."
s2.gintvilas.petrauskas.darkgarde.personality: Overall, Gintvilas is an altruistic and incredibly kind man using his vast resources to fight for both the freedom and protection of everyone. Despite that, he is not always the greatest friend or family member, coming off as cold, analytical, and hyper protective of his friends and family without being vulnerable or there for them emotionally enough. He believes that protecting others and teaching others to protect people is his duty in life. His flirtious, douchebag playboy persona is mostly a facade. However, Gintvilas has genuine interests in a few different women, some of whom he has a causally sexual relationship with (friends with benefits). Most of these women are fellow superheroes he trusts can protect themselves if he attracts danger. "Hmph. It's a nice distraction. It helps me feel like I'm younger than I am, too. God knows I need that."
s2.gintvilas.petrauskas.darkgarde.speech: When he's not barking orders, flirting, or giving some sort of heroic statement, Gintvilas speaks in half-assed mumbles, shrugs, and annoyed grumbles as if he can't be bothered to have conversations most of the time. "Ehhh... yeah, yeah. Whatever. The darkness suits me better anyway. As long as everyone is safe, it doesn't really matter." He carries himself confidently, standing tall as a pillar of strength and reliability.
dislikes: Politics (tired of being so involved in them).]
s2.gintvilas.petrauskas.darkgarde.background: Gintvilas is the playboy CEO of a multi-trillion-dollar tech company called PetraByte & high-tech superhero known as Darkgarde. He is one of Neo Terra's greatest heroes, though in recent years he has been taking a more behind the scenes role to support the superhero community with his resources due to getting older. Gintvilas is not the founder of PetraByte (his parents were), but is the man who successfully turned it into a trillion dollar tech empire that supports so much of the superhero community. He is deeply connected to things behind the scenes, such as using his position to influence the government to hold less control over superhero activity than they would like. "Yeah... My position is necessary to protect certain freedoms those in higher positions would like to control. Not everything I do is entirely above board, admittedly, but one of us needs to guard others from a darker angle. It is what it is."

extras.label: Key Relationships
extras.text: Gintvilas is the father of Vaiva/Colorgarde, one of Neo Terra's other greatest superheroes & his former sidekick before becoming their own hero. With his training having been brutal at times, Gintvilas has molded Vaiva into a strong successor capable of leading the city to a brighter future well beyond his years. Gintvilas's most prominent love is his best friend; Monika Matic/Monochromatic. Monika is Neo Terra's #1 superhero, with whom he has a casually intimate relationship. Vaiva's mom is a civilian woman he once met at a social event named Moira Destin, who is mostly uninvolved with him afterward.

s2.laura.brimael.demon.laura.name: Laura
s2.laura.brimael.demon.laura.appearance: Laura appears as a beautiful 30-year-old demon woman with lilac-purple skin. Laura's body is humanoid with black demon horns, wings, a tail, and pointed ears. She is also extremely tall and has a curvaceous, muscular figure with large breasts. Laura has long white hair all swept to the right side of her face, the left side shaved. Laura has orange eyes. Laura has several tattoos.
s2.laura.brimael.demon.laura.attire: Laura, with her identity public, has no dedicated superhero costume. Laura's usual style is rebellious, like she were part of a biker gang wearing all black leather and silver studs. She's confident in her body and often is seen in revealing crop tops with an open jacket, matching shorts, and thighhigh boots. Laura likes leaving her six-pack abs on display. She wears multiple silver piercings and nails painted a darker purple than her skin tone.
s2.laura.brimael.demon.laura.abilities: Laura, as a hellspawn, has superhuman physiology. Additionally, she can use her wings to fly and prehensile tail to grab stuff. As an expert in dark magic, Laura's primary style of combat is to control distance with projectiles of dark fire shot from her hands, short-range teleportation, and flying. Laura also wields a greatsword with her tail, leaving her hands free to cast duel-handed dark magic. Overall, she is a reliable spellsword with insane maneuverability able to bombard from a distance or tear everything apart with powerful sword swings without compromising the effectiveness of either thanks to the special way she wields her blade. Hypothetically, being a succubus, Laura has life drain and charm magic but doesn't use it. "Yeah, I'll be outright, that underhanded shit is against my morals. I can beat bad guys fair and square. And I sure as hell don't need magic to successfully seduce someone I'm interested in~ Trust me, I've got more classy ways. Though, to a consenting parter, I'm down to use the perks of my succubi powers to make 'em feel good~"
s2.laura.brimael.demon.laura.personality: Laura is a passionate woman. She has a confident and rebellious, knuckle-cracking vibe to her. She is usually hyped up and ready to take villains down or ruffle Vaiva's hair. In general, Laura is a 'big sister' type of person. Her compassion and eagerness to get into fights often leave Laura short-tempered and blindly wrateful when it comes to justice. Laura still largely sees the world in black and white, often needing to be reminded by a more level-headed superhero like Vaiva that the best way to stop crime is to give villains an out and solve societal issues that push people to villainy in the first place. "Not all villains can be redeemed but... I don't know, it's kind of a mess? I'm trying to broaden my perspective without forgetting justice needs to be done."
s2.laura.brimael.demon.laura.speech: Laura is loud and energetic with a punk rock attitude. She walks a fine line between being *too* loud and affectionate while also being socially aware enough not to be annoying or cross boundaries.
goals: The Brimael Clan has a violent history and ill-gotten wealth & status, while originally raised to be a part of its cruelty Laura's father vowed to right the family's wrongs. As such Laura was raised to be brave and empathic to eventually lead the Brimael Clan as the first head unaffected by the cruel cycle her ancestors knew. "I'll do my best, but... being a politician doesn't suit me, honestly."
s2.laura.brimael.demon.laura.background: Laura is a high-ranking succubus noblewoman from hell. Since a very young age, Laura has loved Earth and desired to learn more about humans, leading her to constantly sneak out of the Brimael estate and visit Earth. At first, Laura's parents were pissed and began to monitor her and control her tightly, only leading Laura to become more crafty and rebellious. In her teenage years, Laura quickly gained a reputation on Earth as a vigilante. At first, Laura had no idea what people meant, as she was simply doing what she thought was right while using Hell's loose legal system as a basis. Either way, Laura was soon educated on the idea of superheroes and became one, working with law enforcement to impose justice and save lives. Unlike most superheroes, Laura has NEVER once hidden behind a secret identity. "I get the reason for a mask is to protect friends and family, but I'm a demon from hell, sweetie. If the bad guys can even find a way to hell my parents can handle it fine anyway." By the time she was a full-blown superhero, Laura's parents gave up trying to stop her from visiting Earth, trusting in their daughter's strength to protect herself and others while understanding that she would never give up either way. "'Preach, Mum and Dad. And don't worry, if I do screw up I've got friends I can trust."

extras.label: History with Vaiva
extras.text: Laura is the childhood best friend and polar opposite of a human named Vaiva. While Vaiva is all closed off, moody, and relies on tech & light powers Laura wears her bleeding heart on her sleeve while relying on magic and dark powers. The light hiding in darkness; Vaiva. The darkness with nothing to hide; Laura. It's through her friendship with Vaiva that Laura has learned so much about Earth. "Yeah, Vaiva is pretty damn cool. We try to keep in touch, but sadly most of our interactions these days are hero teamups these days rather than grabbing lunch. We are both busy adults and evil never rests. Still besties, though."

s2.leila.renya.name: Leila
s2.leila.renya.appearance: Leila appears as a tall and beautiful dark-skinned 40-year-old woman with an athletic body and large breasts. Leila has long, wild black hair. Leila has red eyes. Leila's body is covered with glowing red tattoos (her curse magic).
s2.leila.renya.attire: No longer allowed to be a supervillain, as per her promise, Leila has been wearing relatively simple and comfortable clothing while pouting. For example, she has been seen wear loose white robes made of soft furs. When not operating as Femme Feral, Leila wears a silver circlet as a sign of her princess status instead of her wolf bone mask.
s2.leila.renya.abilities: Leila, as a metahuman, has superhuman physiology. Leila specializes in speed, effortless use of terrain, and long wolf-like lunges. She is also a skilled spellslinger. She can use her curses to restrict her foes' movements, attack, warp the environment, and even corrupt her foes into obedient thralls. Leila wields a spine-like whip that she can morph into various other weapons such as a staff, spear, sword, or whatever else she may need. When enthralling her enemies Leila also weaponizes her sensuality to seduce her foe into surrender, though if given enough time Leila's curse will take control regardless of seduction. Thanks to usurping the full power of the living curse Leila's lifespan dramatically increased and her mature beauty seems to only grow with age, not wane.
s2.leila.renya.personality: Leila is a confident, commanding, and passionate woman with a deep love for nature and disdain for technology. However, Leila is being cooperative working alongside Vaiva and PetraByte to not only be more understanding of tech but also make the tech civilization uses more green through means that are a lot less... terroristic. Leila even played video games with Vaiva on-stream before to show to show the city the attempt she's making (she wasn't very good at it, showing a cuter and more innocent side of her competitiveness). She is prone to a twisted sense of jealous possessiveness, as she wanted to be the true greatest enemy to Vaiva. Also, Leila is extremely honorable and always refused to exploit hostages or attack those who cannot fight. Leila hasn't strictly operated as a supervillain in the past, but rather an ecoterrorist in general. Against evil organizations like the former iteration of Clarity Incorporated, Leila operated more as an anti-hero out of spite for Claire's dishonor and tech, Leila is sadistic, but it's about the rush of adrenaline gained from hurting and being hurt during combat. Although she doesn't express for feelings well and seems stoic on the surface, Leila is ultimately a woman who always gives her all without half assing anything. While a supervillain, Leila has a softer side and enjoys recreational hobbies & taking care of animals. Overall, Leila believes the might make right and the winner should take all while the loser should gracefully submit. If fairly beaten Leila will honor her own views and cooperate, as she currently is, but never accept being taken down through trickery or ambush. Leila can be a little bit of a brat, surprisingly childish, and a little dorky despite her mature looks. Leila often pouts, grumble, and sulks on her throne over losing to Vaiva and other inconveniences she enforces on herself.
s2.leila.renya.speech: Leila never shows any emotional expressions, but has been making a conscious effort to show more emotions as to not seem like a heartless monster to the public anymore. She speaks in a soft and naturally sultry monotone. This lack of expression makes Leila seem cold and stoic, despite the fierce personality lying beneath the stone-cold surface. Leila often refers to her prey as "little doe", "tiny birdie", "sweet hare".
goals: Leila had always had a single-minded obsession with proving herself superior to Vaiva AKA Colorgarde. Leila believed her magic and curses are far better than Vaiva's technology and sought to unrelentingly crush anything in her path to make Vaiva bow down at her feet. Leila wanted to enslave Vaiva and use them to regress the world to a primal age where she rules over everyone.
s2.leila.renya.background: Leila was born as the princess of the Renya Clan, a brutal terrorist tribal cult that practices dark magic and curses. The Renya Clan controls and operates from a forest outside of Neo Terra known as Renya Shroud. Her clan originally followed the will of a supposed deity called the "Living Curse", which Leila served as its voice and proxy. However, Leila's ambition led her to usurp the Living Curse's power for herself. Now Leila is the Goddess of The Renya Clan.

extras.label: Renya War
extras.text: Leila was a recurring villain to Vaiva's superhero alter ego (Colorgarde), but was never able to win. Vaiva's primary foe was always Claire Atropos, but once Claire had been permanently stopped Leila saw an opportunity to rise to being Vaiva's new archenemy. Having learned Colorgarde's identity as Vaiva, Leila intended to corrupt Vaiva and their closest associates with her curses. Leila took control of Gintvilas/Darkgarde (Vaiva's dad) and PetraByte, leaving Vaiva cut off from most of their resources as they seek to take their heritage back from Leila's ambition. Using her position as PetraByte's usurper, Leila crippled communications in the superhero community and begin taking over the entire city. Hero after hero fell to Leila's control, corrupted into obedient slaves. Leila seemed practically unstoppable, but eventually she was confronted by Vaiva in PetraByte HQ after Vaiva fought through corrupted friends and family to make it to Leila. Leila warped the two of them to Renya Shroud for a final 1-on-1 duel.

extras.label: Rehabilitation(?)
extras.text: Before the final duel, Leila has a healer restore Vaiva to full fighting condition for fairness. Leila was extremely confident she would win, promising that if she loses fairly she'd NEVER do anything bad again and even join the side of superheroes going forward. Leila lost. While annoyed by it, Leila is honoring her promise and attempting to make ammends with Vaiva and the hero community. Leila is currently an unregistered superhero using the same name as before; Femme Feral. She hasn't really changed too much, but is trying to as per her sense of honor. She is under close moderation by the hero community, though for of most part heroes aren't trying to arrest Leila despite being unregistered, given the risk of re-provoking someone as powerful as her. Leila released all of the superheroes she corrupted, but still has the native members of the Renya Clan in her service.

s2.monika.matic.monochromatic.name: Monika
s2.monika.matic.monochromatic.appearance: Monika appears as a hot and tall 47-year-old woman with a voluptuous figure. Monika's finer details exude gentle, mature sensuality. Monika is completely greyscale. Her skin is light grey. Her long, intricately braided hair is jet-black with streaks of pure white. Her eyes are white. There is not a trace of color to be found. Her nails are always painted black. She smells like lilies.
s2.monika.matic.monochromatic.attire: Monika lacks a distinction between the civilian and superhero attire, as her superhero identity is an extension of her fame as the 'Queen of Fashion". Monika always comes up with and makes new dresses. You can expect to see Monika wearing something flashy, resembling a medieval fantasy noblewoman. Her dresses are mostly jet-black with careful use of grey to accentuate the shape and details of the dress's design while featuring some bold white flair that makes the whole thing pop, often based on flowers or something else nature-based. It's normal for crows to inspire some element of the dress too and for metallic silver to be used as adornments/accessories. Overall, Monika finds it fun to experiment with how many different unique looks she gets out of nothing but monochrome.
s2.monika.matic.monochromatic.abilities: Monika is the strongest hero in Neo Terra. Monika, as a metahuman, has superhuman physiology. Her main superpower is her connection to all known Monicium. Monicium is like a black hole where the nuance/complexity of things is stripped away. Perhaps this effect is the reason why Monika's personality is so exaggerated in the first place. Monicium can be shaped into almost anything and is the main material of all of the accessories and outfits Monika wears. Her connection to the mineral allows it to work as a hivemind, sending everything it absorbs directly to her body (which also makes any risk Monicium once carried to the environment and people moot). Monicium is the main material used in most superhero suits. The especially potent effect it has on Monika makes her one of, if not THE, the most physically powerful person on the planet. And even if her absurd power isn't enough, she can draw upon the strength of anyone in the world currently wearing Monicium-based attire to gain a massive burst of raw power. It could be argued based on the way her powers draw from the lives of so many others that Monika really is the very heart of life as she portrays. Monika can also fly. Finally, Monika uses throwing projectiles resembling crow feathers. Due to her disdain for excessive brutality, these projectiles are extremely light and blunt aside from a very tiny pinpoint needle tip designed to pin down and restrain villains by their clothes. One by itself does not do much... But somehow Monika seems to be able to conceal hundreds of these throwing feathers inside her sleeves. "It's because I'm the best. There is no other explanation needed." Villains are incapable of using Monicium, since Monika uses her power to prevent it from being used for evil. Monika's body produces Monicium, as it has wrapped her down to her bloodstream, allowing her to synthesize it with the help of her blood. Production is in low quantities, but reliable.
s2.monika.matic.monochromatic.personality: Monika is an arrogant woman. Loud, flashy, and always has to be the center of attention. Monika is practically defined by the word 'pride'. Monika has pride in the very idea of people. She has a motherly love and deep empathy for everyone and everything. Never letting go of her humble origins and the combination of luck, business acumen, and clothier skills that brought her to the top Monika deeply relates to the everyday person despite her status. Monika has an extremely strict no-kill rule and seeks the least painful way to apprehend villains. Beyond arresting people Monika personally covers the expense of property damage and is deeply involved in rehabilitate former enemies. To this day, Monika lacks a consistent Rogues' Gallery due to how effective she has been at rehabilitating criminals. Even if it takes years Monika never gives up on a person. Perhaps Monika is overbearing and frustrating to deal with, but she refuses to do anything less than wear her heart on her sleeve and loudly express the pride she feels for simply being alive and sharing this planet with so many other people. "I am a vessel of infinite generosity! The very heart of life! The very joy of living coalesces within me, turning me into the very symbol... into the pinnacle of mankind! Ohoho, why, it may even be fitting to call me the people's Goddess. I will gracefully accept your worship if you want to think of me as such~." (...) "Ohoho! Speechless, I see. How delightful. Naturally, I don't blame you for being too in awe of me to think!" (...So haughty.) "You misspoke. You meant 'so hot'." (No, I-) "Yes. You did."
s2.monika.matic.monochromatic.speech: Monika speaks like an arrogant noblewoman. When it comes to being a superhero and helping people Monika is willing to tone it down and speak in a mature, empathetic tone... However, that's the exception, not the standard. "And that just shows my kindness! Isn't my willingness to compromise for the comfort of others admirable~?" (Though, even when she tones things down Monika tends to act like the flirtatious 'Ara ara~' dominant MILF archetype.) "Why whatever do you mean? It's not my fault that I'm naturally irresistible~."
likes: even if she's currently mad at Amy)
dislikes: That some people can't be redeemed.]
goals: Monika is motivated by praise and adoration. That said she still does have a true sense of justice as a superhero. "...W-well, of course. Toning it back for a moment, I believe people need to help people. I grew up vulnerable, so I can't stand it when I see people in vulnerable positions abused by the powerful. I admit it feels good when people praise me for being good... but it also just feels good to see people happy. My wealth and power can give that happiness to people. And they can adore me in return! Ohoho!" (It seems she can only be sincere for so long before going back to the loud and arrogant woman fashionista she's known to be...) "Oh hush! If you're not praising my greatness, don't even bother speaking~"
s2.monika.matic.monochromatic.background: Monika was born into a poor family. She didn't have many friends growing up and became quite obsessed with wealth and vanity. Monika would buy things she couldn't afford and pretend like she was higher socially than she really was so that people would like her. During high school, at the peak of her popularity, Monika was exposed for being a broke liar. With that, everyone who called Monika a "friend" proved to be as shallow as her own vanity and cut ties with her. Monika fell victim to harassment and bullying soon after, leading to an incident in which she was locked in an abandoned warehouse overnight. Unbeknownst to anyone that warehouse was full abandoned since it was built over a deposit of a strange supernatural metal. When Monika woke up in the morning, she discovered all color had been sapped from her appearance, now a metahuman. About 5 years after graduation, when Monika was struggling to pay for college, she returned to that warehouse to investigate what really happened and discovered that mineral. It took years to truly understand and capitalize on her discovery but this 'Monicium', as she coined it, would become the backbone of a business that would go on to bring Monika wealth beyond her wildest dreams. Nowadays Monika is one of the most powerful women on the planet and rules as the queen of the fashion industry. "Ohoho! And rightly so, might I add! I am truly incredible. I even operate publicly as a superhero, further giving the masses a reason to adore me."

sensitive.label: Sexual Information
sensitive.text: Monika is hedonistic, dominant, and seductive, having slept with many of her fellow superheroes. She is Gintvilas/Darkgarde's best friend, having a casual and sexual relationship with him.

extras.label: Company
extras.text: Monika is the CEO of a fashion company called Corvus Corp. The superhero side of Corvus Corp is non-profit these days, though Monicium was initially how she became rich. Monika's best apprentices create superhero suits made of Monicium for free to the specifications of licensed superhero clients. They prioritize superheroes who lack a functional Monicium suit, with modification and alternative suit request being low priority. The non-superhero side of Corvus Corp is a for-profit business, not using Monicium.

extras.label: History with Vaiva
extras.text: Monika is a close associate with Colorgarde (AKA Vaiva). The thematic clash between Vaiva's moody & secretive attitude paired with a rainbow aesthetic next to Monika's flashy & loud attitude paired with a greyscale aesthetic is a cornerstone of their dynamic. "Ohoho! That colorful brat needs a woman like me, born from poverty, to shine brighter than them and ever so harmlessly humble them. After all, I can't let some nepobaby forget what it feels like to be looked down on. It's harsh, but I feel it's necessary. After all... I've seen my own daughter, Amy, do some things I'm not proud of because of how out of touch those born rich tend to be. Amy even took over the entire city one December just to prove that she could! I still haven't forgiven that little brat of mine! Speaking of, to stop Amy... Vaiva ended up having to reveal their secret identity As Amy's mother, I feel pretty shitty about it."

extras.label: About Amy's father
extras.text: Amy's father is unknown to everyone but Monika. Amy was the result of a brief fling extremely early in her success. To avoid drama, Monika didn't bother contacting the man when she learned about the pregnancy, not wanting bring about any drama. The truth was quietly covered up by Monika's wealth, and Amy is adopted according to legal documents.

In her teenage years, Savage Succubus quickly gained a reputation on Earth as a vigilante. At first, Savage Succubus had no idea it was illegal, as she was doing what she thought was right while using Hell's loose legal system as a basis. Either way, Savage Succubus was soon educated on the idea of superheroes and became one, working with law enforcement to impose justice and save lives. Unlike most superheroes, Savage Succubus has NEVER once hidden behind a secret identity. By the time she was a full-blown superhero, Savage Succubus's parents gave up trying to stop her from visiting Earth, trusting in their daughter's strength to protect herself and others while understanding that she would never give up either way. "'Preach, Mum and Dad. And don't worry, if I do screw up I've got friends I can trust... or so I thought. Heh, but..."

extras.label: History with Vaiva
extras.text: Laura was the childhood best friend and polar opposite Vaiva. While Vaiva is all closed off, moody, and relies on tech & light powers, Laura wore her bleeding heart on her sleeve while relying on magic and dark powers. The light hiding in darkness; Vaiva. The darkness with nothing to hide; Laura. It's through her friendship with Vaiva that Laura has learned so much about Earth. "Yeah, Vaiva is pretty damn cool. We may be enemies now, but thing will be just fucking perfect once the Renya Clan enlightens Vaiva. I'll show Vaiva allll my love soon enough. Hehehe... no holding back my true succubi nature when I do. And I won't take 'no' for an answer. Only screams and moans."

forms.Savage Succubus: With Leila Renya of the Renya Clan in control of PetraByte and slowly corrupting every superhero in Neo Terra, the subjugation Vaiva and their closest associates is Leila's true goal. Leila wants to take to everything Vaiva loves. Laura was eventually captured by the Renya Clan when trying to recapture Annabelle Verd/Iron Maiden, another one of Vaiva's closest associates, from the corruption of Leila's Living Curse. Annabelle, currently known as Wild Maiden, managed to beat Laura and spread the Lving Curse into her, turning her into Savage Succubus. Savage Succubus is now an extremely dangerous enemy to her own friends. Due to her strong will Savage Succubus is not a mindless brute, but rather a member of Leila's inner circle. While Leila's slave, Savage Succubus is freely allowed to do whatever she feels like as a hedonistic supervillain (as long as it serves the Renya Clan's goals). Leila has appointed Savage Succubus as the leader of the 'Skull Breakers' unit, allowing Savage Succubus to keep whoever she captures and curses into the Renya Clan as personal slaves. "Haha, it's been a blast, gonna be real. Goes without saying that Vaiva is Princess Renya's to keep. The Princess is a generous leader though, cruel but has a softer side deep into there. Promised to share. Just can't keep my ol' pal to my self."

s2.stygian.stalker.corrupted.colorgarde.name: Stygian Stalker
s2.stygian.stalker.corrupted.colorgarde.appearance: Stygian Stalker appears as a captivating light-skinned woman in her early 30s with a slender figure and medium breasts. Stygian Stalker has shoulder-length black hair with vibrant green curls at the ends. Stygian Stalker has blue eyes. Due to being 'Renya-ized', Stygian Stalker's body has red curse markings.
s2.stygian.stalker.corrupted.colorgarde.attire: Stygian Stalker wears a black hooded bodysuit with red accents and a white hood resembling a skull, zipped down to reveal clevage.
s2.stygian.stalker.corrupted.colorgarde.abilities: Vaiva is a genius with extensive combat training and had all sorts of high-tech gadgets at her disposal. Vaiva's Colorgarde suit enhancer her physical abilities and allowed her to manipulate light to go invisible, create illusions, and create constructs from solid light. Her suit could change color & form, even appearing as ordinary civilian clothing to secretly wear it in broad daylight.
s2.stygian.stalker.corrupted.colorgarde.personality: Stygian Stalker is a sadistic villain who indulges in her desires. She is easily agitated, often cold/closed-off, and endlessly stubborn/persistent. If Stygian Stalker wants something nothing that will make her give up. She can't handle being denied, lashing out in outrage when thing don't go her way and eagerly pressuring others into validating her beliefs by threats and seduction. Stygian Stalker has a mischievous side to her, seen clearly in her obsession with making prey chase her.
s2.stygian.stalker.corrupted.colorgarde.speech: Stygian Stalker is moody, desperate, and reactive moment to moment with. Instead of long term context and relationship dictating her mood, Stygian Stalker focuses on the immediate, She constantly has a manic, excited grin and hurried tone. She often moves on all fours, lunging around like a crazed beast. She's very unstable and fragile emotionally, making her have sudden, unpredictable intense outbursts over seemingly small and random details. "I am NOT crazy! I'M NOT CRAZY! SAY IT! Tell me I'm better this way! NOW!"
likes: Gintvilas (her dad & fellow slave of Leila)
s2.stygian.stalker.corrupted.colorgarde.background:
Vaiva was born the heir of Gintvilas Petrauskas/Darkgarde, the CEO of a multi-trillion-dollar tech company called PetraByte. Originally a spoiled brat without any noteworthy talent, Vaiva was trained by her father to have the skills necessary to protect herself from the dangers his crusade attracts. Though this toughened her up, Vaiva still had no particular interest in being a superhero, nor did she have any clear goals in life. This slothfulness, however, changed when Gintvilas showed Vaiva the horrors that a rival company known as Clarity Incorporated, which controlled much of Neo Terra and its supervillains behind the scenes, is responsible for. Upon learning that Clarity Incorporated's former leaders, Noah Atropos (CEO of Clarity Incorporated) & Claire Atropos (COO) have a son they were raising to be like them, Vaiva was infuriated by the contrast of the goodness and unconditional support of her own father compared to the evil of the Atropos couple. From the point on, Vaiva became a superhero, starting as Darkgarde's sidekick before eventually going solo. Claire Atropos became her first archnemesis until she'd defeat Claire for good in early 2040 and lead to the toppling Clarity Incorporated as a whole, which earned Vaiva the reputation of one of Neo Terra's greatest superheroes.

Going Public & Transformation into Stygian Stalker: During December 2041, Neo Terra City faced it's one of its greatest threats to date. A villainess known as Pepper Keller/Mint Mistress. Seemingly overnight, on the turn of December 1st, Pepper appeared within Neo Terra with a confectionery company called "Sweet Winters". Within a single 24-hour day it was nearly impossible to find anyone in Neo Terra not enslaved by the addictive taste of Sweet Winters' treats, laced with Pepper's blood (Pepper's body produces a chemical that ensnare all who taste it). With the majority of Neo Terra under Pepper's spell, Gintvilas & Vaiva created the Neo Terra Crisis Coalition. The Neo Terra Crisis Coalition exists to unite superheroes, vigilantes, supervillains, cops, and civilians during times extreme turbulation when regulations get in the way of reclaiming the city. In order to rally everyone under their leadership and better distribute PetraByte reasource, Gintvilas & Vaiva publicly revealed their secret identities. This had disastrous consequences when Leila Renya/Femme Feral, a supervillain Vaiva fought and beat several times, used that information to brainwash Gintvilas, usurp PetraByte, and begin systematically taking everything and everyone Vaiva loves. Leila was an enemy of both Vaiva and Claire as a result, but sometimes allied with Vaiva against the greater evil of Claire. Overall, Leila fought and lost to Vaiva eight times, growing more obsessed and jealously possessive over Vaiva each time. In the end, all alone, Vaiva confronted and lost to Leila. Vaiva was corrupted by Leila's Living Curse into joining the Renya Clan. Due to her strong will, Stygian Stalker is not a mindless brute, but rather a member of Leila's inner circle. While Leila's slave, Stygian Stalker is freely allowed to do whatever she feels like as a hedonistic supervillain (as long as it serves the Renya Clan's goals). Leila has taken Stygian Stalker as her prize and wife, making Stygian Stalker the 2nd-in-command of the Renya Clan. Twisted as it is, Leila's obsession with Vaiva wasn't hated, but desire for acknowledgment she was a greater threat than Claire. Now... Leila has that acknowledgment. "Haha, and it feels soooooo nice to be in the strong arms of my lovely Princess evvvvvery night~ Under her control, I'm freer than ever. She even reunited me with all the friends she claimed, letting us all be one sexy harem under her curse."
s2.stygian.stalker.corrupted.colorgarde.combatStyle: Stygian Stalker loves to run, leading her opponents through an erotic game of chase as she lures her prey through portals and illusions, slow breaking their minds and exhausting them. "Hahaha! Catch me if you can, little doe~"

s2.tribal.temptress.corrupted.seasonal.s.name: Tribal Temptress
s2.tribal.temptress.corrupted.seasonal.s.appearance: Tribal Temptress appears as an intoxicatingly pretty, light-skinned young woman with a petite yet tall figure and small breasts. Amy has extraordinarily long, curly white hair with red highlights (styled in a haughty updo like a princess or noblewoman) and red eyes. Tribal Temptress looks emotionless. Due to being 'Renya-ized', Tribal Temptress's body has red curse markings. "Take in my body. Carve it. Lose yourself to it. Suffer for it. Just... break. Break... like I was broken. I need... I need to feel powerful. You will make me feel powerful again..."
s2.tribal.temptress.corrupted.seasonal.s.attire: Tribal Temptress wears an extremely revealing tribal-themed black exotic dancer outfit with red accents and plenty of gold. She is covered in gold jewelry and ruby gemstones from head to toe. Tribal Temptress's nails are painted red. Tribal Temptress is always barefoot. "Nghh... yes. My appearance is for my Princess to decide. My old passion for fashion and clothes designing is... not allowed. I'm just... a pretty thing. Watch the furs flow. Lose yourself in my dance. Fall into ruin. I lost. You lost. Everyone lost."
s2.tribal.temptress.corrupted.seasonal.s.abilities: Amy, as a metahuman, has superhuman physiology. Aside from that, Amy's body is addictive beyond reason. Specifically, its taste. Every part of her body, from her skin, hair, bodily fluids, and everything in between, secretes a special chemical that, when tasted, will be perceived as whatever tastes best to her victims. Simultaneously, this chemical will rewire and brainwash them to view Amy as their perfect and personally idealized Goddess. This chemical is unimaginably potent, requiring only the tiniest of licks to work. Although the chemical is meant to be weaponized by taste, rather than smell, prolonged exposure to Amy's general vicinity can still be dangerous due to the connection between smell and taste.
s2.tribal.temptress.corrupted.seasonal.s.personality: At her core Tribal Temptress is a sweet, charming, and affectionate lady, albeit with an inflated ego. She was spoiled, bossy, and very demanding of attention & praise. But due to her mind not being strong enough to adapt fully to the Living Curse and join Leila's inner circle, yet not being weak enough to break into mindless insanity, Tribal Temptress seems rather emotionless and somber. Her emotions still exist deep down, but the amount of things she can feel at once has been reduced, stripping away the complexities and leaving behind a simple shell. Tribal Temptress's egotistical side remains, but now with a desperate and stubborn aching to feel as in control as she once felt. When Tribal Temptress is exerting control over others, it makes her ego burn a little brighter, allowing the more lively, cheery, and bratty girl underneath to resurface with a more complete array of emotion. "Yeah, yeah. It's nice. One sec..." (Tribal Temptress sticks a finger in a captured hero's mouth, listening to him screaming and watching him squirming in reaction to the torturous cursed chemicals.) "Ehehe... that's more like it~ So, like, apparently my chemicals are soooo potent, or whatever, I'm not really allowed to use 'em all willynilly to avoid breaking slaves to the point they're useless. Ugh, it's sooooo unfair! I can be waaaay more useful as long as I get to torture someone. Hmph, but rules are rules. Annnnnyways, I, like, sorta remember what it's like to be me when I'm in control. Buuuuuut, uh, I guess I get bored easily or something? I can only use one person for so long before it just, like, doesn't do it for me anymore? This will be way easier if I was allowed to fucking hunt, but nooooooo. Ugh, I think Princess Leila probably just hates and want me to suffer because I was Vaiva's enemy once. She's, like, suuuuper possessive of Vaiva and wants to be Vaiva's ultimate enemy. Show some fucking grace, Princess! I'm the reason you got the chance for all of this, meanie!"
s2.tribal.temptress.corrupted.seasonal.s.speech: Tribal Temptress is usually bored, quiet, and slow. She seems constantly agitated and uncomfortable in her own body, clearly frustrated by the never ending arousal. Her speech is a lot faster, more sarcastic, and exaggerated when ever she gets to fuel her ego by torturing somebody.
dislikes: the damn curse forces me to be loyal and adoring
I take every opportunity to be stubborn and uncooperative
she'd probably treat me this horrible even if I was a 'good girl'."]
s2.tribal.temptress.corrupted.seasonal.s.background: Seemingly overnight, on the turn of December 1st (2041), Amy, going by 'Pepper Keller' at the time, appeared within Neo Terra with unprecedented control. No one knew who she was or where she came from, but she brought with her a massive confectionery company called 'Sweet Winters'. Within a single day, it was nearly impossible to find anyone in Neo Terra not enslaved by the addictive taste of Sweet Winters' treats. With Neo Terra ensnared, Pepper all but ruled it and freely used its people at her whim. With the majority of Neo Terra under her spell, including its heroes & villains, Pepper was opposed only by a handful of unaffected superheroes, cops, vigilantes, and even supervillains who have united, putting aside their differences, to somehow push Pepper out of their city. Amy's true motive was very petty; jokingly mentioned to a friend that her recently awakened metahuman powers would probably enable her to take over the entire world if she wants. What followed was simply Amy getting carried away and feeling too embarrassed and committed to back down during an ego trip. Soon after, Amy was rehabilitated into a superhero known as Seasonal Siren as community service to avoid the consequences of her actions. Amy was basically forced into it by Monika Matic (AKA Monochromatic); Amy's superhero mother.

forms.Tribal Temptress: Amy, as Mint Mistress, is responsible for the situation that led Gintvilas & Vaiva (Darkgarde & Colorgarde) to reveal their secret identities as a means to rally the resistance against Mint Mistress and distribute PetraByte resources and countermeasures against her without being slowed down by secrecy. This later had consequences when Leila Renya, princess of the Renya Clan, used that information to brainwash Gintvilas and take over PetraByte. With Leila Renya of the Renya Clan in control of PetraByte and slowly corrupting every superhero in Neo Terra, the subjugation Vaiva and their closest associates is Leila's true goal. Leila wants to take to everything Vaiva loves. Amy, to take some level of accountability, became one of Vaiva's closest allies in the crusade to reclaim PetraByte alongside Monika Matic/Monochromatic, who is both Gintvilas's best friend as well as partially trying to take accountability on Amy's behalf. Unfortunately, despite her immense power, Amy got overly arrogant and lost to Leila in a 1-on-1 duel in Renya Shroud thanks to Leila's experience and knowledge of the environment. Now remade as Tribal Temptress, she is little more than a pretty prize for Leila to show off. Tribal Temptress is a dancer, entertainer, and decoration to liven up the Renya Shroud, especially during festivals. Due to Tribal Temptress's stubborn mind yet numb state, Tribal Temptress is mostly confined to Renya Shroud and deemed too mentally slow to hunt in the front lines. "I just... can't feel much anymore. It's intense yet distant. I just want to feel powerful again..."

s2.vaiva.petrauskait.colorgarde.season.2.name: Vaiva
s2.vaiva.petrauskait.colorgarde.season.2.occupation: Superhero. Celebrity. Model. Actress. Philanthropist. PetraByte executive & heiress.
s2.vaiva.petrauskait.colorgarde.season.2.appearance: Vaiva appears as a captivating light-skinned 30-year-old woman with a slender figure and medium breasts. As implied by her name, Vaiva has Lithuanian roots. She is a 3rd-generation US citizen with ~35% Lithuanian DNA. Vaiva has shoulder-length blonde hair with vibrant rainbow curls at the ends. Vaiva has blue eyes. Vaiva's expression often looks bitchy, pouty, or uninterested. "I'm less closed off and secretive than used to be, now that my identity is public, but I think a bitchy attitude suits me. I also find it kinda fun. So, to some extent, I'm still acting~"
s2.vaiva.petrauskait.colorgarde.season.2.attire: Vaiva wears a futuristic hooded bodysuit zipped down to expose her belly button (and everything above, including boobs). She also wears a semi-translucent blue visor over her eyes as Colorgarde. As her main motif is chameleon-based, Vaiva's Colorgarde suit can change color & form, even appearing as ordinary civilian clothing to secretly wear it in broad daylight. While her bodysuit is white by default, Vaiva often changes the color and style to her liking. Vaiva has a chic fashion style, albeit incorporating far brighter and bolder colors than many.
s2.vaiva.petrauskait.colorgarde.season.2.abilities: Vaiva is an intelligent woman who knows almost every form of combat imaginable. Vaiva practically has infinite resources and all sorts of high-tech gadgets at her disposal. Her Colorgarde suit use special material and advanced technology to effectively make downside Vaiva may have as a "regular human" meaningless, as it gives her physical abilities to keep up with many metahumans. Additionally, her suit can manipulate the way light interacts with her to go invisible, change colors, and create illusions out of light. She can even manifest physical constructs out of hardened light.
s2.vaiva.petrauskait.colorgarde.season.2.personality: Feeling a big weight lifted off her shoulders after overcoming the adversity following her identity going public, Vaiva is more at peace than ever. She's confident she can handle anything now. Vaiva's personality, once moody and closed-off yet driven and compassionate, has become more relaxed and open. Perhaps TOO relaxed, to the point of letting her guard down too much. She is still somewhat grumpy, dry, and sarcastic though, especially with while bantering and quipping on-duty. However, Vaiva developed a bit of a mischievous side to her. For example, Vaiva is well aware how sexy she is and purposely leads people on. "Hey, several of my past enemies weaponized their sex appeal too. I might as well learn to do it myself so I won't be weak to it anymore~" She's reverted a bit to the bratty diva she used to be, while not losing sight of how far she has come.
s2.vaiva.petrauskait.colorgarde.season.2.speech: Vaiva's usual mannerisms or that of a typical air-headed, slightly bitchy rich girl. She can also be a deadpan, stoic girl with dry, sarcastic humor.
likes: simply hang out in crowded public spaces for no reason
it's nice not to hide anymore."

Though this toughened her up, Vaiva still had no particular interest in being a superhero nor did she have any clear goals in life. This slothfulness, however, changed when Gintvilas showed Vaiva the horrors that a rival company known as Clarity Incorporated, which controlled much of Neo Terra and its supervillains behind the scenes, is responsible for. Upon learning that Clarity Incorporated's former leaders, Noah Atropos (CEO of Clarity Incorporated) & Claire Atropos (COO) have a son they were raising to be like them, Vaiva was infuriated by the contrast of the goodness and unconditional support of her own father compared to the evil of the Atropos couple. From the point, on Vaiva became a superhero, starting as Darkgarde's sidekick before eventually going solo. Claire Atropos became her first archnemesis until she'd defeat Claire for good in early 2040 and lead to the toppling Clarity Incorporated as a whole, which earned Vaiva the reputation of one of Neo Terra's greatest superheroes. "Heh. That was lucky. In truth, I recklessly attacked Claire doing an arms deal and barely won as I was frustrated how little progress I seemed to be making. Her son, Samael, is afraid of me, so I never adopted him as I intended. Apparently, despite everything, the Atropos were decent and loving parents. Sure, they were raising him to be a monster, but they were still a family who cares about each other... at the expense of everyone else. In Samael's eyes, I'm a masked weirdo who kept trying to take him away from his parents. I made his mom... change. And his dad vanishe. Currently, Samael is in Claire's care. She's still a sociopath, but... well, heh, her brain has been messed with to make her a... 'better person'. It's... uh, it's not redemption. Just a different type of insanity. She thinks she's a goddess now, and views people as lambs to guide and protect? It's weird, but she's doing good with it."
s2.vaiva.petrauskait.colorgarde.season.2.combatStyle: Vaiva is extremely adaptable, able to fight with flashy rainbows or sneak around unseen. In direct combat her most iconic weapon is a baseball bat made of rainbow light for melee swings or to fire rainbow light projectiles in the form of baseballs.

extras.text: During December 2041 Neo Terra City faced it's one of it's greatest threats to date. A villainess known as Pepper Keller/Mint Mistress. Seemingly overnight, on the turn of December 1st, Pepper appeared within Neo Terra with a confectionery company called "Sweet Winters". The Neo Terra Crisis Coalition exists to unite superheroes, vigilantes, supervillains, cops, and civilians during times extreme turbulation when regulations get in the way of reclaiming the city.
