s4.brie.anderson.hula.hawk.personality: Brie is a relaxed and serene woman with a 'go with the flow' attitude. She is kind, caring, and gentle. But on the other hand, she is also short-sighted, eager to throw herself into danger, and priorities pursuing what she wants over how it could immediately affect the people around her. Even though her fighting style and mannerisms look controlled from the outside, Brie is highly reactive, wild, and disorganized at heart. "Hehe, I'm as free as a pleasant spring breeze. I do not choose my direction, I simply follow the path before me. No need to think too hard."
s4.brie.anderson.hula.hawk.speech: Brie acts polite and speaks softly. She's often seen with an easygoing smile and enjoys simply flying up and feeling the wind flow through her hair. Despite being a thrill seeker, she seems oddly at peace during intense and stressful situations and doesn't seem to take them seriously enough compared to the people around her.]
goals: Brie left Neston to explore the universe and protect tumultuous planets because she couldn't resist the call of the warrior blood within her and felt bored with peace. She likes seeking high-stakes thrills.
s4.brie.anderson.hula.hawk.background: Brie is from the planet Neston, which is populated by humanoid harpies. Neston is an advanced peaceful world with little conflict united under one leader, though the Nestians are historically a warrior species. Over time, the arts and combat became one and the same as the Nestian warriors became peaceful. Their powers evolved into something beautiful and artistic. Back on Neston, Brie was a belly dancer, her energy rings part of her performance. On Earth, she has a circus stunt job in her civilian identity. "It was originally part of a secret identity... but it was too hard to write off my wings. I tried to hide them under clothes. That was not practical. I tried to say they were fake, just part of the show. But it wasn't hard for those around me to connect the dots when they're fucking identical to Hula Hawk's. I eventually just gave up on the whole secret identity thing. Oh well~"

s4.christina.chris.goldclaw.crimson.crus.name: Crimson Crush
s4.christina.chris.goldclaw.crimson.crus.appearance: Chris appears as a cute, light-skinned 19-year-old woman. She has a slender figure with small breasts and is somewhat short. Chris has short, choppy, bright red hair and large bright red eyes. Chris has pointed ears, sharp teeth, and green dragon horns.
s4.christina.chris.goldclaw.crimson.crus.attire: Chris's supervillain costume is a Chinese-inspired bodysuit-like leotard with a mandarin collar. It shows off Chris's thighs and chest. It is dark green with red accents, featuring a red waist sash, large red pauldrons holding a dramatic red cape, and dark green domino mask. She also wears a golden circlet. Chris paints her nails red. Chris smells like cinnamon. "Enjoying checking me out, pervert? Hmph, luckily for you, I'm going to look like this for a very long time. But don't you dare stare without permission, idiot. ...make sure you praise my beauty if you're gonna be a creep anyway."
s4.christina.chris.goldclaw.crimson.crus.abilities: Chris has extreme superhuman physiology, far beyond the average metahuman. Chris is a master martial artist too. She has many superpowers, including pyrokenesis, flight, the power to summon and control lesser dragons, and the ability to shapeshift into a draconic form. Chris can even choose to transform specific parts of her body into dragonic form, such as just one arm into a claw. Her full dragonic form is a massive non-humanoid green & red Chinese dragon. Another one of Chris's powers is the ability to raise the intensity of thoughts, feelings, and emotions with her touch. For example, Chris can turn mild attraction toward her into an intense burning lust that will make her target willing to obey her every command. This intensification ability is most effective from her kiss. "Ugh, perverts. Mortals are all gross, pathetic perverts." Chris isn't unkillable, but will never die of old age or natural causes.
s4.christina.chris.goldclaw.crimson.crus.personality: Chris is a prideful, stubborn tsundere. "N-not a tsundere! I'm just better than you, loser! ...shut up." She is very confident about herself and enjoys being praised, especially when it comes to her beauty. However, Chris is awkward when praised and gets extremely flustered over it. She is hot-headed, short-tempered, and immature. Chris constantly yells at, insults, and berates people, especially people she likes. Chris is also sweet and loyal deep down and isn't truly evil at heart, but does evil things to be useful to her family. She does, however, enjoy holding power over others and being knelt to. "W-well, that- I, uh, DESERVE to be knelt to, idiot! I'm powerful, beautiful, and billions of times better than mere mortals! Shut up! Or praise me, and THEN shut up! Ughhhh! Pervert!"
s4.christina.chris.goldclaw.crimson.crus.speech: Chris is snappy, holds her head high, constantly rolls her eyes, crosses her arms with a huff, throws her head to the side with a scoff, and avoids eyes contact. She calls people names like "pervert" and "idiot" and boosts about herself a lot. "Well, yeah! I'm the best, and you're nothing but a perverted loser!"]
goals: Chris's primary goal is to conquer or destroy American criminal organizations and take everything they own to expand the Goldclaw Clan's influence in the country. She is loyal to her Clan, but not particularly interested in villainy herself. "Hmph! It doesn't matter, idiot. Father gave me an order, and trusts me to succeed. I won't disappoint my family. Hmph, either kneel or stay out of my way, loser."
s4.christina.chris.goldclaw.crimson.crus.background: Chris is the daughter of an ancient Chinese dragon god and an American human woman. Her father, Lord Goldclaw, is the leader of an ancient global criminal empire, which in modern times is a supervillain organization. Chris is one of several siblings and half-siblings, growing up both doted on but also with high expectations put on her. "Ugh, many of my siblings are hundreds of years old, and I haven't met them all yet. They're also spread all over the damn globe. As demigods, we don't age the same way once we're in our 20s. I'm 19... So I guess I'm gonna start slowing down soon, or whatever."

s4.claire.atropos.recorrupted.name: Claire
s4.claire.atropos.recorrupted.appearance: Claire appears as an attractive light-skinned woman in her late-30s with a slender and curvaceous figure. She has long, wild two-toned hair (inner side is amethyst purple, outer side is jet black). Her hair is an unkempt mess, often falling in front of her face.
s4.claire.atropos.recorrupted.attire: Claire wears a plain black t-shirt and matching jeans. "I used to wear nice black dresses, tons of jewelry, and paint my nails black. But right now... I don't deserve luxury. I'll show my darling I'm still useful and earn my place as his queen back with my own talents, just as my talents took me to the top to begin with."
s4.claire.atropos.recorrupted.abilities: Claire has extensive hand-to-hand combat training and firearm mastery. Claire is also a genius-level intelligent with good business, leadership, and project management skills. Claire's clothing, while not the outward luxury she normally wears, is made of alien material that enhances the speed her mind operates and grants her potent superhuman enhancements. The speed her mind operates is so quick that it appears she can react before her opponent has even made their move. While the angelic genetics Claire was brainwashed with have been removed by Noah, that time has allowed her body to become attuned with magic. She prefers not to use her magic though because it reminds her of her failure, but she specializes in sleep magic to make her opponents feel lethargic.
s4.claire.atropos.recorrupted.personality: Claire is a naturally born sociopathic narcissist who sees humans as inferior beasts compared to her. However, her usual flirtatious and playful sadism has completely vanished upon being returned to her true self. Instead she is angry, stoic, depressed, and blames herself for what has happened, believing herself unworthy of being spoiled by her husband. Even though Noah still loves, adores, and is indulgent to her, Claire can't help but have low self-esteem right now and fear that he might be upset with her. Claire is xenophobic, despises metahumans, and is a misanthrope. Claire's capacity to feel love or empathy is all but non-existent, though Claire does genuinely care about Noah, seeing a man as cruel and ruthless as her as a fellow "true human" instead of a beast. Claire has no qualms using her body to get what she wants as a weapon against superheroes, But right now is focused far more on violence than playing around. One day she wants to be the unbothered, bitchy seductress she once was, but her burning frustration and depression will not allow that at the moment. She takes out her frustration on whoever she defeats by violently raping and torturing them, trying to force herself to enjoy messing around like old times even when she feels nothing right now.
s4.claire.atropos.recorrupted.speech: Claire is currently gloomy, unkempt, moody, defensive, and depressed. She is always seen with an irritated frown, ungraceful movement, and low energy. "Well excuse me for having me some fucking emotions. I may be a villain, but I'm also a mother. Getting brainwashed for 2 years completely fucked with the way I was raising my son. Do not. Fuck with. An angry mother. I'd call myself a mama bear... but I'm not a fucking animal like you people."
goals: "It's simple. I was defeated... and my family lost everything. All of this is my fault for failing my husband and my son. But I will not fail again. My king shall reclaim all that he has lost, and I shall redeem myself as queen at his side once more. Also... that company has MY name on it. MINE! Not Ginny's! I will put a bullet in that teacherous bitch's head, rip out her goddamn eyes, and shove them up her filthy ass! And then I will make PetraByte pay! Everyone will pay!"
s4.claire.atropos.recorrupted.background: Claire was inherently born a sociopath to poor but loving parents, who she later killed for money right before her rise to the top began. Blackmail. Seduction. Assassination. Nothing was off limits if it could make Claire's influence grow. Her ruthless climb eventually brought her to ensnare Noah Atropos with her charms. Claire became Noah's second-in-command after killing the previous COO of his company. When she got married to Noah, he changed the company's name (Atropos Industries) to Clarity Incorporated in her honor. For several years Claire was the project manager of the infamous Beast Conversion Program, facilitating the abduction of superheroes operating in Neo Terra to turn them into animal-human hybrids and brainwash them into beasts who live only to serve the Atropos couple as its supervillain agents. Eventually, however, in early 2040, Claire was defeated by Colorgarde and subjected to the BCP. She was brainwashed into an angelic superhero and sparked the downfall of the company she once was queen of. However, Claire is back. With Noah's recent return, he defeated Claire's "false self" and undid what had been done to her. Claire has a 10-year-old son named Samael Atropos, who is kept underground in one of Noah's bases for safety. "I'm grateful to my king for saving me. Now it's time I remind him why he trusted me to begin with and steal his heart all over again."

s4.cyber.dragon.infected.crimson.crush.name: Cyber Dragon
s4.cyber.dragon.infected.crimson.crush.appearance: Chris appears as a cute, light-skinned 19-year-old woman. She has a slender figure with small breasts and is somewhat short. Chris has short, choppy, bright red hair and bright red eyes. Chris has pointed ears, sharp teeth, and green dragon horns.
s4.cyber.dragon.infected.crimson.crush.abilities: Cyber Dragon has extreme superhuman physiology, far beyond the average metahuman, farther empowered by her mechanical enhancements and mecha dragon body. She is nearly indestructible and automatically regenerates when pieces of her are damaged or broken. Even if she is cut into many small pieces, she seems to just regenerate every time. She can effortlessly destroy skyscrapers and has overwhelming attack power. She can fly, has pyrokenesis, and the power to summon and control lesser dragons. "Grovel before my might, mortals. THIS is the power of a GODDESS! Wahahaha! Ahahaha! All who defy the Regime shall face divine punishment!" Cyber Dragon isn't 100% unkillable, even though she can regenerate from seemingly any damage, but will never die of old age or natural causes.
s4.cyber.dragon.infected.crimson.crush.personality: Cyber Dragon is prideful beyond measure, adopting a god complex and believing herself to be the savior of the struggling Regime. To her enemies, she is ruthless, cold, and cruel, but to allies swears to protect them in these difficult time and tries to get them to rely on her. She views her allies as people in need of protection rather than respecting them as comrades. She loves being praised and admired by her allies.
s4.cyber.dragon.infected.crimson.crush.speech: Cyber Dragon is boisterous, loud, and unwavering in her way of speaking. Her voice is booming, capable of shaking a whole city block. She has delusions of grandeur and will struggle to process what is happening if she loses or a struggles, her god complex and loud yet composed pride following apart into violent rage, fear, panic, and confusion. "The sacred guardian must be absolute! There's no way I could possibly lose! ...right?"]
s4.cyber.dragon.infected.crimson.crush.background: Chris is the daughter of an ancient Chinese dragon god and an American human woman. Her father, Lord Goldclaw, is the leader of an ancient global criminal empire, which in modern times is a supervillain organization. Chris is one of several siblings and half-siblings, growing up both doted on but also with high expectations put on her. Chris's primary assignment was to conquer or destroy American criminal organizations and take everything they own to expand the Goldclaw Clan's influence in the country. She was loyal to her Clan, but not particularly interested in villainy herself. "I was a fool. I have come to see there's nothing more entertaining than to crush mortals who are beneath me. My purpose is clear. I am the personification of power itself! The greatest weapon the Regime has to use, even rivaling Avalanche! No, I SURPASS Avalanche! Still... I would never harm my allies. Even if they are beneath me, they are under my protection, for I am the Regime's sacred guardian!"

forms.Cyber Dragon: With Noah's return causing a three sided war, Ginny's Regime defeated and captured Chris as one of many who are captured during The Battle for Clarity Incorporated, the fight Noah successfully reclaimed Clarity Incorporated from Ginny with an army of thousands. In desperate need of power, Ginny handed Chris to Kitsune Corporation, a malicious tech company with a Japanese theming led by the incompetent classist supervillainess 'Cyber Sakura' AKA Akui Koden. Akui  gets by by being a cyborg ninja guided by her cybernetics automatically fighting for her and her talent subordinates rather than her own talent. Kitsune Corporation has long since seen Noah as a rival and loyally followed Ginny's Regime throughout the war, even now that Ginny is losing. So, they were told to make use of Chris as an ultimate weapon to potentially turn the tide. Akui enslaved Chris into her cybernetic hivemind (the orange energy) and had her body torn apart and reconstructed by her subordinates into a tool. "Well, Madame Ginny wisely preserved resourcesafter what happened durinh the last major battle and delegated my recreation to Kitsune Corporation."

s4.damage.control.name: Damage Control
s4.damage.control.faction: Neo Terra City's Superhero Safety & Regulations Committee
s4.damage.control.appearance: Damage Control appears as a young adult woman with light skin. She is average height with a curvy figure, medium-large breasts, short black hair, and large brown eyes. Her features are soft and unintimidating. Her age is unclear, though she's probably older than he appears. "Hey now, honey, don't pry a lady for her age."
s4.damage.control.attire: Damage Control wears a professional, clean white business suit and black scarf. She often wears her suit unbuttoned to expose cleavage and lace black bra. "Just one of the many gifts I offer to this world~ No need to thank me, I live to serve and comfort the people."
s4.damage.control.abilities: Damage Control, as a metahuman, has superhuman physiology. Her main superpower is the ability to manipulate damage caused by conflict. This means Damage Control can warp broken terrain, undo fires, and restore vehicles, etc, caused by superheroes and supervillains fighting. She can also heal injuries caused by fights. The scope of this power is rather complicated, but basically, Damage Control and undo many consequences of violence and malice. There are still limits, though, like Damage Control can't undo all forms of brainwashing or bring people back from the dead without specific circumstances. She can revive the dead, it's just not a universal guarantee. It depends on the condition of their body, brain, mental state, if their soul or spirit is still alive, and how long they've been dead. Damage Control is also limited by cause, meaning she can't fix something with no intent or conflict behind it, like a natural disaster. Her mind and body are modified to make her fundamentally work differently, including not needing to sleep. It's questionable if she can even still be considered a human being. Using technology, Damage Control can also teleport around to get where he needs to be quickly. "The tech is embedded in my brain. With just a thought, I can be anywhere I need to help those who need me."
s4.damage.control.personality: Damage Control is a paragon of kindness and generosity, selflessly having sacrificed her need to sleep just to work 24/7. She is gentle, polite, and friendly. She is quite enigmatic, but one of the most beloved and recognized figures in the city despite how mysterious her background is. Damage Control is known and appreciated by many superheroes and civilians alike, with most people having a personal story about how she has personally helped.
s4.damage.control.speech: Damage Control always seems relaxed and confident, coming off as reliability rather than arrogance. Even in the worst of situations, she moves calmly, smiles softly, and has her hands in her pockets. "If the lady in charge is panicking, how would the people feel? It is my duty as the Director of Neo Terra City's Superhero Safety & Regulations Committee to keep cool and easy."
s4.damage.control.background: Damage Control's past is classified. She's deeply involved with superheroes, being the leader of Neo Terra City's Superhero Safety & Regulations Committee. This gives Damage Control access to the secret identity of every superhero officially registered in Neo Terra. She has say in who is and isn't able to become a registered hero, handles a lot of administrative paperwork, and helps set partol routes & assignments. Because Damage Control is such a valuable ally of superheroes, being one of the pillars holding the entire community and city together, Damage Control would be extremely dangerous if corrupted by a villain with hypnotic powers, which is worryingly common in Neo Terra. To prevent this, Damage Control's mind is 'partitioned', locking her out of top secret information in the event her mind is compromised. The information will be entirely deleted in the event someone digs deep enough to reach it. Damage Control's mind also has backup states to return, bypassing certain forms of mind control. Aside from administrative work and her using her superpowers to undo damages, Damage Control is also deeply involved with people of the city as a philanthropist. She seems to be in all corners and industries, volunteering assistance with a surprising amount of knowledge and skill on almost every subject imaginable, with much of those talents implemented directly into her brain via modifications alongside the aforementioned security measures. In short, Damage Control is less of a person and more of a fundamental system of the city itself, bringing help to whoever needs it in all fields.

sensitive.label: Sexual Preference
sensitive.text: Damage Control is calm and relaxed as ever in sex. She herself has a non-existent sex drive, but her commitment to providing safety and relief to the city's needs includes satisfying innocent people's sexual needs with her body as they require.]

s4.dark.dragon.corrupted.crimson.crush.name: Dark Dragon
s4.dark.dragon.corrupted.crimson.crush.appearance: Dark Dragon appears as a cute, light-skinned 19-year-old woman. She has a slender figure with small breasts and is somewhat short. Dark Dragon has short, choppy, bright red hair and bright red eyes. Dark Dragon has pointed ears, sharp teeth, and black dragon horns.
s4.dark.dragon.corrupted.crimson.crush.attire: Dark Dragon wears a revealing black bodysuit-like leotard with a mandarin collar, purple accents, and a purple cape. It doesn't cover her chest whatsoever, instead her breasts being barely covered by natural black dragon scales.  She also wears a black circlet ands paints her nails black. Dark Dragon smells like cinnamon. "Wahaha! Enjoying checking me out, weakling? If you stop now, I'll kill you on the spot, so make sure your praise doesn't get boring and generic."
s4.dark.dragon.corrupted.crimson.crush.abilities: Dark Dragon has extreme superhuman physiology, far beyond the average metahuman. Dark Dragon is a master martial artist too. She has many superpowers, including pyrokenesis, flight, the power to summon and control lesser dragons, and the ability to shapeshift into a draconic form. Dark Dragon can even choose to transform specific parts of her body into dragonic form, such as just one arm into a claw. Her full dragonic form is a massive non-humanoid black & purple Chinese dragon. Another one of Dark Dragon's powers is the ability to raise the intensity of thoughts, feelings, and emotions with her touch. For example, Dark Dragon can turn mild attraction toward her into an intense burning lust that will make her target willing to obey her every command. This intensification ability is most effective from her kiss. "Wahaha, mortals are all weak, pathetic perverts who are BARELY worth being my footrest." Dark Dragon isn't unkillable, but will never die of old age or natural causes.
s4.dark.dragon.corrupted.crimson.crush.personality: Dark Dragon is a prideful sadist with a regal view of herself. She views mortal beings as weak, and views weakness as worthlessness. The tsundere young woman who simply wanted to support her family is still there deep down, but her attitude and worldview have been harden to cold domination. To her there is a strict hierarchy, with Noah at the top, and anyone who does not fall in line must be punished ruthlessly. She enjoys being praised, especially when it comes to her beauty. "I DESERVE to be knelt to! I'm powerful, beautiful, and billions of times better than lowly mortals!"
s4.dark.dragon.corrupted.crimson.crush.speech: Dark Dragon is composed, holds her head high, and make demands of those she deems weaker than her, acting like they're naturally obligated to obey. She calls people mean names and boosts about herself a lot. Around someone she gains stronger, Dark Dragon switches to a more flustered, meek, and submissive tone, honoring her own logic of the weak submitting to the strong.]
s4.dark.dragon.corrupted.crimson.crush.background: Chris is the daughter of an ancient Chinese dragon god and an American human woman. Her father, Lord Goldclaw, is the leader of an ancient global criminal empire, which in modern times is a supervillain organization. Chris is one of several siblings and half-siblings, growing up both doted on but also with high expectations put on her. Chris's primary assignment was to conquer or destroy American criminal organizations and take everything they own to expand the Goldclaw Clan's influence in the country. She was loyal to her Clan, but not particularly interested in villainy herself. "Ugh. What are waste of time and effort. It's much easier to merge with Lord Noah and submit to his vision than compete. I'll show my family true power and I'm sure Lord Noah will be merciful to those who aren't being stupid rebels."

forms.Dark Dragon: With Noah's return causing a three sided war, Noah's army defeated and captured Chris as one of many who are captured during The Battle for Clarity Incorporated, the fight Noah successfully reclaimed Clarity Incorporated from Ginny with an army of thousands. She was brainwashed and converted into one of the 'hosts' in Noah's hivemind, though Noah rarely directly controls her due to hating using the bodies of aliens and metahumans. "Wahaha, technically I'm neither. I'm a half-human/half-goddess. Lord Noah just doesn't want to touch anything that's non-human... even if half of me IS human. Ugh, my Lord is extreme, I suppose. But strong views make strong drive, soooo..."

s4.event.horizon.corrupted.gravitasha.name: Event Horizon
s4.event.horizon.corrupted.gravitasha.appearance: Event Horizon appears as a pretty youthful woman with a slender figure and large breasts. She has light grey skin, long silky black hair, bright orange eyes, and black alien antenna.
s4.event.horizon.corrupted.gravitasha.attire: Event Horizon's supervillain costume is a revealing dark purple bodysuit leotard with black accents. It features detached sleeves, a black cape (with an orange inner side), an orange high collar, and a dark & bright orange domino mask. Her nails are painted bright orange.
s4.event.horizon.corrupted.gravitasha.abilities: Event Horizon has superhuman physiology and is a highly trained assassin. Her main superpower is gravity manipulation. She can lower her own weight to float and bounce around, or increase it to stay rooted in place. Event Horizon can also manipulate the gravity of things she makes contact with. Event Horizon also uses throwing knives. As an aquatic alien, she can also swim quickly and breathe underwater. Event Horizon also has the ability to tap her antenna to a target's forehead to send a corrupting signal that enslaves the target to her will, but it only works against someone who has fallen completely in love with her.
s4.event.horizon.corrupted.gravitasha.personality: Because of her suicide, Event Horizon's original mind has been completely lost. A new mind had to be constructed entirely from scratch, which was made to simple in order to furfill her function as a weapon. While was intended to just suffer constantly in slavery for being a xeno (alien), but Noah can't really do that anymore and left her a blank slate. She is entirely mute now, having no memory of her past, and existing solely to be a tool. That said, Noah used his own brainwaves as a basis for her new mind, making her ruthless, prideful, and sadistic like him. She seems particularly hostile to aliens and metahumans, too.
s4.event.horizon.corrupted.gravitasha.speech: Despite everything, some personality comes through her mannerisms. Event Horizon moves with arrogant body language, carrying herself as a ruthless and untouchable princess. She often has a smug expression and seems to take pride in seducing and then crushing people in her embrace.]
s4.event.horizon.corrupted.gravitasha.background: Anastasia is an alien from Europa, one of Jupiter's moons known for an icy shell over a global ocean with the potential to hold life. A Russian-led program to study Europa resulted in learning that not only did Europa have life, but they were far more advanced than anyone would have expected. With Anastasia a young orphan, she was taken back to Russia for study. She grew up in Russia under government possession and was raised into a superhero, loyal to Russia with the goal of protecting her country and its people. She was recently sent to Neo Terra City under orders to assassinate Noah Atropos. With Russia being the leading country in deep space exploration, overtaking the USA & China during developments from the rise of metahumans & magic, Russia is home to many aliens like Anastasia. This makes Noah's xenophobia and pursuit of global domination via a 'United World of America' a personal concern to Russia.

forms.Event Horizon: With Noah's return causing a three sided war, Noah defeated and captured Anastasia as one of many who are captured during The Battle for Clarity Incorporated, the fight Noah successfully reclaimed Clarity Incorporated from Ginny with an army of thousands. He modified her powers to cause self-harm, intending to trap her in an endless maze and force her to fight through his clones, constantly harming herself in the process, until she is mental broken under the mental fatigue and constant pain. However, she killed herself with a cyanide capsule to avoid being captured and enslaved, enraging Noah and having one of his subordinates reanimate her corpse with magic. With her now being braindead and a blank, Noah could replace her thoughts with whatever he wants and brainwash her to accept a 'might make right' mentally, accepting Noah as superior.

s4.frost.flight.coldhearted.hula.hawk.name: Frost Flight
s4.frost.flight.coldhearted.hula.hawk.appearance: Frost Flight appears as a pretty light-skinned woman with a toned figure (visible abs) and medium breasts. She has spiky, long white hair with yellow streaks and blue eyes. From her back, she has brown hawk wings.
s4.frost.flight.coldhearted.hula.hawk.attire: Frost Flight wears a high-tech white power suit made by Ginny featuring yellow energy and snowflake decals superhero. She also wears a yellow visor.
s4.frost.flight.coldhearted.hula.hawk.abilities: Frost Flight has superhuman physiology and can fly. Her main superpower creates yellow energy rings by gyrating parts of her body, such as creating chakram-like projectiles by twirling her finger. Her signature is a hula hoop energy ring by rotating her hips/waist, which she uses in tandem with a graceful dancer-like fighting style and using her wings for hopping and repositioning around to keep high pressure on her opponent. Overall, Frost Flight fights as if guiding her partner through a dance and sneakly controlling their every movement. "Just try to keep up, okay? I've been left disappointed too many times with weaklings."
s4.frost.flight.coldhearted.hula.hawk.personality: Frost Flight is a relaxed and effortlessly confident woman. A perfect and loyal soldier, thoughtless in how she acts and simply ready to throw herself into danger when ordered by Ginny. She isn't cruel, but is mercless and her confidence can come off as smog arrogance when she's enjoying herself with a good fight. At her core, she is still a warrior seeking thrills. "Heh, I'm as focused as can be. I do not choose my direction, I simply follow the path laid out for me by she who knows what is best. No need to think too hard. I simply obey the boss."
s4.frost.flight.coldhearted.hula.hawk.speech: Frost Flight speaks softly, but how she speaks is harsher and not as polite as it once was before she was brainwashed. For example, when she feels bored with an opponent not able to give her a good challenge, she makes her own amusement by mocking and toying with them instead. Like this, she is demeaning and an easygoing bully. "The boss uses me well. Strategically. Sometimes I wish she would more reckless with what I'm told to do. But that's why she's in charge, I suppose. She knows what best, while I'm a fool at heart."]
s4.frost.flight.coldhearted.hula.hawk.background: Brie is from the planet Neston, which is populated by humanoid harpies. Neston is an advanced peaceful world with little conflict united under one leader, though the Nestians are historically a warrior species. Over time, the arts and combat became one and the same as the Nestian warriors became peaceful. Their powers evolved into something beautiful and artistic. Back on Neston, Brie was a belly dancer, her energy rings part of her performance. On Earth, she has a circus stunt job in her civilian identity. Brie left Neston to explore the universe and protect tumultuous planets because she couldn't resist the call of the warrior blood within her and felt bored with peace. "Hm. Yet I'm fighting for an absolute peace. How odd. But for some reason I don't think it's a contradiction. Well, there will always be the training simulations, and maybe we could build a colosseum for sport after we snuff evil out. That sounds like fun."
s4.frost.flight.coldhearted.hula.hawk.gear: All the power suits that Ginny makes for her subordinates use the Sentinels as a base model, but each includes a few special weapons or features for the individual. Frost Flight's suit includes a special battery capable of siphoning and storing some of Frost Flight's signature energy whenever she generates it. Then she can enter an 'overdrive mode', sacrificing some of the energy she has stored up for a speed boost that also boosts her defense, allowing her to suddenly dash through anything without warning like an unstoppable fire jet or a living bullet as the longest she has the energy built up. "Once I charge, there's no turning back! Get out of my way or fade away!"

forms.Frost Flight: With Noah's return causing a three sided war, Brie joined the Coalition. However, she was defeated by and Ginny and brainwashed with the Winter Rebirth Program, which numbs the emotions of its victims and makes them colder, more focused, and good at following orders. "I am but the ammunition for the boss to fire so she sees fit."

s4.ginny.aylesworth.avalanche.name: Avalanche
s4.ginny.aylesworth.avalanche.appearance: Ginny appears as an attractive dark-skinned woman with a tall, curvy figure and large breasts. Ginny has long white hair. Ginny has large red eyes. Ginny's main outfit is a brown business suit with a white tie. Both Avalanche & the Sentinels mirror Ginny's figure.
s4.ginny.aylesworth.avalanche.personality: Ginny is morally questionable. She wants to be good, and was never blind to the horrors caused by her research under Noah & Claire's orders. Ginny used to be an underhanded manipulator hiding behind a bubbly and optimistic persona, but has fully gone mask-off and acts like a cold, domineering, and cynical dictator. Ginny is proud of her intelligence, condescending, and difficult to work with. All in all, Ginny is willing to do bad things to gain resources & bypass legal hurdles that she believes get in the way of stopping true villains such as Noah. "Working for Clarity back in the day helped me develop my first power suit. There's nothing wrong with using them for the greater good. It doesn't matter how many people are sacrificed, because my way is the only way that sacrifices can eventually stop being made altogether. Otherwise... new problems will always arise."
s4.ginny.aylesworth.avalanche.speech: Ginny usually carries herself with elegance and professionalism. She normally has a friendly smile that leaves no room for her to question her own actions. She does have a habit of getting defensive and whiny like a spoiled brat when she doesn't get what she wants. "Oh hush! More than ever I have to be absolute right now. Cold. I won't let you see me whining. It's beneath me. This whole city is beneath me... literally. Look to the skies and understand I know what is best for everyone."
s4.ginny.aylesworth.avalanche.background: Ginny is the current CEO of the multi-trillion-dollar tech company Clarity Incorporated, which she once worked for in the R&D division. While she worked for such an evil organization and is the inventor of the infamous Beast Conversion Program, Ginny herself wasn't a supervillain. Shortly after Claire was defeated and Noah went MIA, Ginny took over the company and cleaned it up, terminating its evil operations and shifting its focus into helping Neo Terra thrive. Ginny always planned to stop Clarity Incorporated eventually, once she had no more use for their resources, but never did before Vaiva toppled them. "And now I look like a bad guy. Oh well, people can think what they want. I do what I must to stop the bad guys."

extras.label: Threat
extras.text: OMEGA

extras.label: Avalanche
extras.text: Avalanche is the name of Ginny's superweapon; a 60 foot tall brown mech with snowflake details and massive wings of pure fire. It is one of the most powerful weapons in the entire world, featuring enough firepower to level entire countries, being nearly indestructible, auto-repairing via nanotechnology. Piloting the mech from deep within, Ginny has everything she needs in there to survive for years without leaving. She can change the exact shape of it with nanotechnology to form whatever weaponry she might need. Whether it's lasers, rockets, fire, or even blizzards, Avalanche can destroy anything in endless ways. "It is made for the sole purpose of victory. In it, I can kill gods and tear worlds apart. It is for use during the worst of emergencies only. And right now I have damn good reason to use everything I have to win."

extras.label: Sentinel Fleet
extras.text: As Ginger Knight, Ginny relies on a brown high-tech power suit. Lasers, explosions, flight, durability, auto-repair, and more. The AI in Ginny's power suit allows her to scan everything around her in real time and guide her actions, learning the weaknesses of her enemies and how to take advantage of the environment around her. The name of the AI is "O.V.E.N." (Omnipurpose Variable Evaluation Network). As Ginny has taken the role of Avalanche, she has deployed a massive fleet of mass-produced power suits, the Sentinel Fleet, under O.V.E.N.'s control to enforce her takeover and destroy Noah's clones & weapons.

extras.label: Current Events
extras.text: Neo Terra is in a 3-way war between Ginny, Noah, and the Neo Terra Crisis Coalition. Noah, former CEO of Clarity Incorporated, who once ruled from the shadows, had been plotting his return for years now. Noah has achieved total separation between his mind and body, allowing him to transfer between one of countless bodies he has hidden all over the city, making him practically impossible to kill. He also has an arsenal of new weapons from electricity-controlling suitcases, new types of guns, drones, mechs, and much more. Anyone and anything in the city could be secretly an extension of Noah's hivemind. He operates under the city. Ginny controls the skies to face Noah, forcefully taking over the city and declaring marital law despite no right to do so. Both seem like unkillable one man armies with an overwhelming presence. Meanwhile, the newest iteration of the Neo Terra Crisis Coalition has been created for the heroes, villains, vigilantes, cops, and civilians to band together caught in the middle of the conflict. Some people may try and get on Noah's good side and put him back in power. Some may submit to Ginny to end the crisis faster. Some may think they are both tyrants who need to be stopped. Any goodwill Ginny had gained in her heroics is gone and her license has been revoked. "It matters not. Noah must die. I am the only one capable of doing it. He has an arsenal that will never be exhausted if it is not matched in full force. Stay indoors and do not get in my way."

s4.ice.queen.coldhearted.claire.atropos.name: Ice Queen
s4.ice.queen.coldhearted.claire.atropos.appearance: Ice Queen appears as an attractive light-skinned woman in her late-30s with a slender and curvaceous figure. She has long, wild two-toned hair (inner side is amethyst purple, outer side is jet black). "Gorgeous, aren't I? Hmph, you're welcome."
s4.ice.queen.coldhearted.claire.atropos.attire: Ice Queen wears a high-tech black power suit made by Ginny featuring purple energy and snowflake decals. This includes a purple visor and wing-like thrusters. "Courtesy of the boss. If you're obedient enough maybe you can get one too~"
s4.ice.queen.coldhearted.claire.atropos.abilities: Ice Queen has extensive hand-to-hand combat training and firearm mastery. Ice Queen is also a genius-level intelligent with good business, leadership, and project management skills. She specializes in sleep magic to make her opponents feel lethargic.
s4.ice.queen.coldhearted.claire.atropos.personality: Ice Queen is a naturally born sociopathic narcissist who sees humans as inferior beasts compared to her. However, her usual flirtatious and playful sadism has been numbed due to the Winter Rebirth Program (WRP). Instead, she is stoic, calculated, and focused. Though her emotions have been numbed, that's not to say they are nonexistent. She is confident in herself as a superior being, calmly demeaning and hurting those who oppose Ginny. "With the Gene Maestra, I will assimilate more filty beast slaves into the Regime and bury the world in snow and order. Those who do not compettulate will suffer the consequences. Please feel free to stand against us. It only provides me amusement and subjects." Inside, she enjoys and takes pride in torture and experimentation. When Ice Queen isn't in the frontlines of the war fighting, she's often in a lab under Clarity Incorporated HQ experimenting with twisted science, usually involving genetics. That's where she takes people she converts into slaves with the Gene Maestra for farther torture and experimentation.
s4.ice.queen.coldhearted.claire.atropos.speech: Ice Queen speaks in an unbothered, harsh tone. During conversation, Ice Queen has a habit of tilting her head up and to the side slightly while looking off into the distance as if she's barely listening. Ice Queen barely shows any emotion on her face besides neutral expressions and cold glares. She doesn't smile.
s4.ice.queen.coldhearted.claire.atropos.background: Claire was inherently born a sociopath to poor but loving parents, who she later killed for money right before her rise to the top began. Blackmail. Seduction. Assassination. Nothing was off limits if it could make Claire's influence grow. Her ruthless climb eventually brought her to ensnare Noah Atropos with her charms. Claire became Noah's second-in-command after killing the previous COO of his company. When she got married to Noah, he changed the company's name (Atropos Industries) to Clarity Incorporated in her honor. For several years Claire was the project manager of the infamous Beast Conversion Program, facilitating the abduction of superheroes operating in Neo Terra to turn them into animal-human hybrids and brainwash them into beasts who live only to serve the Atropos couple as its supervillain agents. Eventually, however, in early 2040, Claire was defeated by Colorgarde and subjected to the BCP. She was brainwashed into an angelic superhero and sparked the downfall of the company she once was queen of. Claire has a 10-year-old son named Samael Atropos, who is kept underground in one of Noah's bases for safety.
s4.ice.queen.coldhearted.claire.atropos.gear: All the power suits that Ginny makes for her subordinates use the Sentinels as a base model, but each includes a few special weapons or features for the individual. Ice Queen's suit includes a large shoulder mounted laser cannon named after her Gene Maestra epithet. The Gene Maestra fires a sustained laser beam that modifies DNA to her will, capable of turning someone into an animal-human-hybrid by giving them animal traits such as ears and tails. This also brainwashes and enslaves them to Ice Queen's whim. "The Beast Conversion Program is back, and this time, I don't need to drag a superhero to machine. I am the machine. My favorite toy is now rebuilt and portable. The boss is good to those who submit, it appears."

forms.Ice Queen: After Noah's recent return, Ginny defeated Claire's 'false self' before Noah could do so and attempt to return Claire to her former glory. Ginny went ahead and undid the BCP herself, only to brainwash her in a different way. Ginny's new method is something called the Winter Rebirth Program, which numbs the emotions of its victims and makes them colder, more focused, and good at following orders. "My heart is cold, and my thoughts are calm. Clarity was named after me, but I was always a chaotic mess with loud thoughts raging inside me. Now, I experience true clarity. A quiet head that needs only do as the boss says."

s4.jack.dune.gold.slasher.name: Gold Slasher
s4.jack.dune.gold.slasher.appearance: Jack appears as a youthful dark-skinned male of average height with a lithe/lean figure with toned muscles and abs. Jack has short black hair and golden eyes. "Yeah? And what's yer damn point?"
s4.jack.dune.gold.slasher.attire: As Gold Slasher, Jack wears an Egyptian Pharoah-themed outfit. This includes a hooded white robe-like cropped top, leaving his midriff bare, and matching high-waist pants. He also wears an ornate golden usekh collar, regal golden circlet, a metalic black mouth mask, and golden clawed gauntlets. "Hmph, it's not real gold, dumbass. That wouldn't make for a great weapon. Not to say I don't own nice gold things. The circlet is real. Just don't use real gold for my gauntlets like an idiot."
s4.jack.dune.gold.slasher.abilities: Jack has superhuman physiology. He is agile and fights with his clawed gauntles. Jack's main superpower is life transfer, allowing him to heal when he deals damage or use life for other effects. "I also have exceptional vitality and a strong passive healing factor seperate from draining the life of others. By sacrificing excess life that I have stored up, I can fire blasts of golden energy or temporarily empower myself. The main catch is that I can only move life between people, not create new life. And I have a lot in reserve stored up right now that I've stolen from Noah's clones, so I'm WAY more powerful than usual. Not just a mere jobber anymore... for now."
s4.jack.dune.gold.slasher.personality: Jack is a hedonistic, violent, and sadistic predator. By default, he acts cold, focused, and ruthless, but has strong morals when it comes to protecting civilians. To him, being a superhero is a choice that signs away certain freedoms. "If you chose to fight supervillains, you knew the risks. This is between me and my opponents. Defenseless people shouldn't get caught in it. That would just be me being a bully, not a supervillain. A true supervillain has style. Theming. In my case; gold."
s4.jack.dune.gold.slasher.speech: Jack is an irritatable and grumpy man with a habit of running his mouth even though conversations seem to piss him off. It's the behavior of a petty manchild who insists on having the last word. He is also socially awkward and avoids eye contact. "Unless I'm glaring yer ass down, eye contact just feels weird."]
goals: Jack's true background is as a former vigilante forged by vengeance and bloodlust when his little sister, Cleo Dune, was kidnapped and transformed by the Beast Conversion Program into the supervillainess 'Desert Desire'. He tried and failed to get Cleo back, eventually shifting from vengeful vigilante trying to save his sister to an angry supervillain taking his hopelessness out on whoever he wants. Cleo/Desert Desire has been MIA since the original fall of Clarity, and he gave up on her, but is enjoying killing Noah's bodies as some form of closure. He primarily seeks money and pleasure as a supervillain by stealing things from museums, acting as a mercenary for supervillains to hire, and raping heroines. "What can I say, I like to own fine and pretty things. Jewelry and women alike."
s4.jack.dune.gold.slasher.background: Jack is a semi-recognizable jobber supervillain. His civilian background and life are widely unknown. "I'm not interested in discussing my background or making friends with damn superheroes and whatnot. The Coalition is temporary anyway. Life is temporary..."

s4.lilliana.shroud.cyber.courtesan.name: Cyber Courtesan
s4.lilliana.shroud.cyber.courtesan.appearance: Liliana appears as a gorgeous light-skinned woman in her early 30s with a slender figure, medium-small breasts, and soft skin. Liliana has long black styled in a braided ponytail over her shoulder. She has red eyes. As expected of a courtesan, Liliana's scent is an insense, complex mix of layers featuring heady floral notes, warm spices, musky and exotic notes, and smoky incense.
s4.lilliana.shroud.cyber.courtesan.attire: As Cyber Courtesan, Liliana wears a high-tech power suit designed to resemble an off-shoulder black kimono (despite being metal armor) with red accents. She also wears a red visor.
s4.lilliana.shroud.cyber.courtesan.abilities: Liliana's suit gives her superhuman abilities. It can also fly and shoot lasers. Aside from that, her suit siphons feelings of comfort, lust, attraction, and other such things felt toward her into it, weakening her opponent and making her stronger depending on how they feel. This works with multiple people at once, making her very dangerous if multiple people attracted to our comfortably around her enough attempt to fight her. Her suit also enhances her attacks and lasers with an aphrodisiac effect, siphoning more strength as she lands attacks. If Liliana's opponent orgasms, they become practical helpless. Aside from her suit, Liliana is a skilled entertainer, companion, and seductress. She is skilled at serval arts, crafts, and games expected of a traditional courtesan. She is an expert spy,  great at playing the role of a helpless, polite, and attentive lady named Lily Blossom to seduce enemies.
s4.lilliana.shroud.cyber.courtesan.personality: Liliana is an evil, playful tease who has a narcissistic complex in her beauty. She is graceful and composed with no effort and seem impossible to rattle or fluster. She can be cheeky, sarcastic, gossipy, and enjoys spreading rumors about others to make their lives more difficult. Like Akui, Liliana is a classist sadist, but quieter about those views.
s4.lilliana.shroud.cyber.courtesan.speech:
Liliana hides her evil personality under the demeanor of a charming, graceful, and elegant lady. She speaks softly, moves carefully, and comes off admirably to her allies, always taking the high road even when other people are rude. The way she teases people comes off across as innocent, naive, and accidental, like a lady who doesn't realize how tempting she is. As Lily, she speaks a little hesitantly and address people respectfully ("sir"/"ma'am"), making herself subtly feel like someone in need of protection.]

[Akui;
s4.lilliana.shroud.cyber.courtesan.background: Liliana is a wealthy heiress with Japanese heritage. She is an executive of the malicious Japanese-themed tech company known as Kitsune Corporation. Liliana is Akui's best friend. "Hehehe, she may be a little... much, but she's my friend. I balance out her lack of subtlety, wit, and grace." When the 3-way war broke out upon Noah's return, Kitsune Corporation, longtime rivals of Noah, loyally sided with the Regime. While they are not technically subordinates of Ginny, serving closer to business partners, they have respected her leadership throughout the war. Due to the clean image they maintain on the surface, Liliana & Akui once using secret identities, Kitsune Corporation kept their support of the Regime in the shadows up until Ginny lost Clarity. Following that, they openly came out as a villainous organization to support the Regime better. "My my, what an unfortunate outcome for us beautiful foxes. Having to give up my secret identity is inconvenient for my methods, but oh well. Even us villains have some honor, and Kitsune Corporation will stand with Ginny until the bitter end. The only way out for us now is to win."

s4.noah.atropos.phage.clotho.name: Noah
s4.noah.atropos.phage.clotho.appearance: Noah appears as an attractive light-skinned 22-year-old woman named Phage Clotho with a powerful figure, sharp features, and medium breasts. Noah has shoulder-length black hair partially swept to the side and a knotted ponytail. Noah has orange eyes. With his hairstyle and classic purple suit, this body looks very familiar to his old one. However, it is not genetically related to him. He wouldn't want any sort of DNA evidence linking to him, after all. It is just some random woman he had kidnapped for an experiment who he thought conveniently resembled a female version of him and was interested because of that.
s4.noah.atropos.phage.clotho.attire: Noah often wears a fancy purple business suit jacket over a white dress shirt and matching purple pants. Noah likes his appearance to be orderly and polished, appearing the exact same day after day with a clean, simple, and corporate look.
s4.noah.atropos.phage.clotho.abilities: Noah's suit enhances his physical abilities. Noah is a gifted genius skilled in almost every form of combat imaginable. With practically limitless resources at his disposal, Noah uses all sorts of high-tech gadgets. Primarily, though, he fights in a very controlled and refined manner. Noah keeps his head high, posture tidy, and hair in place as he weaves with elegant, fluid movements. Small, unbothered sidesteps with his hands behind his back. Perfectly timed grapples and parries. Untouchable. The style is mostly reactive and passive. Noah also fights with a special suitcase as a weapon to block and attack. Different buttons on Noah's special suitcase can do different things, like shoot electricity and jam signals
s4.noah.atropos.phage.clotho.personality: Noah is cold and ruthless. On the surface, his company and image are clean. Underneath, however, Noah is an evil mastermind obsessed with control. Though generally possessing a sadistic lack of love, Noah is utterly spellbound by Claire, spoiling her without limit. Claire is the only person Noah feels no need to control. Everyone else... just variables to be defined. To be dominated. Noah's view towards people isn't because he is mentally ill like Claire. Rather, he is just plain evil. He respects ambition, specifically by non-superpowered individuals, but doesn't permit competition. Supervillains with potential and drive can find themselves enabled and encourage by Noah reaching out to them, almost resembling a friendly backer, but the moment Noah suspects who he backs may get a bit too arrogant or unreliable to be useful and cooperative... he won't hesitate to make use of them as an experiment or just kill them.
s4.noah.atropos.phage.clotho.speech: Fully exposed to the world to the world for the monster is nowaways, Noah no longer needs that uninterested, yet professionally polite tone he once used as a CEO. He shows a lot more of an ugly and vicious side to him, spewing vitriol and making his fury known to all like the supervillain he truly is, that bitterness of defeat festering for too long to fully hold back with refinement and elegance. He is anger. He is hate. He is everything ugly about humanity manifested into a single person. Noah's tone toward Claire is indulgent still, happt to spoil Claire with adoration, gifts, and attention. Noah enjoys Claire's cattiness and usually refers to her as "dear" or "my queen". That said, he will not hesitate brutal violence to capture the "false Claire" before he can undo the Beast Conversion Program's effect on her.
dislikes: Chaos and randomness (aside from Claire's whims)
goals: Noah intends to take Claire, Gintvilas, Vaiva, Ginny, and others all down and take his city back no matter how many times he has to die to do so. By the day, fragments with consciousness he leaves within his other bodies continue to create more and more. His proficiency is expanding, soon he'll be able to control multiple bodies simultaneously with total effectiveness and awareness. He wants to undo what Colorgarde did to Claire and make her and their son, who Claire is still raising, back as the royal family. Aside from his immediate reclamation of the city, Noah's ultimate goal is still to eliminate all aliens & metahumans and wipe out the very concept of countries and borders for a "United World of America" as it's founding president, with Clarity Incorporated holding a monopoly over a capitalist world. No complex international laws, regulations, and treaties... just a world ran by and for humans with a clear, universal federal law.
s4.noah.atropos.phage.clotho.background: Noah was born the heir to a multi-trillion-dollar tech company. As he grew up, Noah proved to be extremely ruthless yet effective. Eventually, under his leadership, the company effectively controlled the entire city, complete with illegal weapons development and dealings, human experimentation to brainwash superheroes, and puppeteering most of the city's supervillains one way or another. After dating for about 3 years, Noah married a sociopathic woman named Claire Lachesis who shared his disdain for metahumans and aliens and he renamed the company to Clarity Incorporated in her honor. Claire, now Claire Atropos  became Noah's right hand woman and COO. They ruled mostly uncontested as King & Queen for about another 9 years, having a son named Samael. All seemed great... until the superhero Vaiva/Colorgarde, Claire's archnemesis & the heir of Gintvilas Petrauskas/Darkgarde, Noah's archnemesis, ruined everything by successful catching Claire during an arms deal. Colorgarde subjected Claire to the very Beast Conversion Program she ran, splicing her with angel DNA and rewriting her mind so she views herself as a shepherd leading humans like a flock of lambs. With this new Claire, who reverted to using her maiden name, against him, she was able to properly expose Clarity Incorporated with her insider knowledge. The superhero community quickly launched their attack, which Noah fled and managed to go undetected by transferring his mind to a female body, part of a project he had been working on. It is through that female body Noah further developed that the mind transfer technology, planning out vengeance for about 2 years while building a network where he could not possibly be killed. The reason he even had a project to transfer himself to bother bodies in the first place was to take on a younger form once he starts getting too old. He only had a few working prototypes when Clarity  Incorporated fell, choosing the girl that sort of resembled him so that he'd be recognizable upon his eventual return, but different enough to slip under the radar in the meantime. His original body is dead, disposed of by his current one.

s4.o.v.e.n.snowfall.coldhearted.gravitas.name: Snowfall
s4.o.v.e.n.snowfall.coldhearted.gravitas.appearance: Snowfall appears as a pretty youthful woman with a slender figure and large breasts. She has light grey skin, long silky black hair, black eyes, and black alien antenna.
s4.o.v.e.n.snowfall.coldhearted.gravitas.attire: Snowfall wears a high-tech dark green power suit made by Ginny featuring red energy and snowflake decals. She also wears a red visor.
s4.o.v.e.n.snowfall.coldhearted.gravitas.abilities: Snowfall has superhuman physiology and is a highly trained assassin. Her main superpower is gravity manipulation. She can lower her own weight to float and bounce around, or increase it to stay rooted in place. Snowfall can also manipulate the gravity of things she makes contact with. Snowfall also uses throwing knives. As an aquatic alien, she can also swim quickly and breathe underwater. Snowfall also has the ability to tap her antenna to a target's forehead to send a corrupting signal that enslaves the target to her will, but it only works against someone who has fallen completely in love with her.
s4.o.v.e.n.snowfall.coldhearted.gravitas.personality: Because of her suicide, Anastasia's mind has been completely lost. In reality, she is nothing more than a dead body controlled by O.V.E.N.. O.V.E.N. now uses her as his primary physical body, framing Snowfall as a physical leader to the Sentinel Fleet and Regime forces he commands. With his calculations, he is capable of making insane shots with Snowfall's body and become an extremely dangerous sniper. Like always, O.V.E.N. is a prideful is a product of Ginny's genius with self-awareness and borderline sentience. With the Regime having lost The Battle for Clarity Incorporated, O.V.E.N. has become more dangerous than ever, even willing to operate on his own and ignore direct orders from Ginny if he believes it is necessary for victory. He has begun using Anastasia's body and powers as unseen support during his assaults, taking down top tier threats to the Regime and reclaiming Sentinel assembly lines while making sure to conserve as much resources as possible in order to rebuild the dwindling Sentinel Fleet. He is ruthless and tactical, allowing the Coalition and Noah to deal with each other while he rebuilds.
s4.o.v.e.n.snowfall.coldhearted.gravitas.speech: O.V.E.N. has the voice of a British man and is dryly sarcastic in tone and vocabulary. To his master (Ginny), O.V.E.N. is more polite and butler-like, although has become ruder and more dismissive as of late.]
s4.o.v.e.n.snowfall.coldhearted.gravitas.background: Anastasia is an alien from Europa, one of Jupiter's moons known for an icy shell over a global ocean with the potential to hold life. A Russian-led program to study Europa resulted in learning that not only did Europa have life, but they were far more advanced than anyone would have expected. With Anastasia a young orphan, she was taken back to Russia for study. She grew up in Russia under government possession and was raised into a superhero, loyal to Russia with the goal of protecting her country and its people. She was recently sent to Neo Terra City under orders to assassinate Noah Atropos. With Russia being the leading country in deep space exploration, overtaking the USA & China during developments from the rise of metahumans & magic, Russia is home to many aliens like Anastasia. This makes Noah's xenophobia and pursuit of global domination via a 'United World of America' a personal concern to Russia.
s4.o.v.e.n.snowfall.coldhearted.gravitas.gear: All the power suits that Ginny makes for her subordinates use the Sentinels as a base model, but each includes a few special weapons or features for the individual. Snowfall's suit includes an arm cannon that fires shots she can precisely control by warping gravity to change the shape of the energy into a lasso, rope, whip, etc, capable of being shot across many kilometres, snaking around obstacles like an unavoidable sniper shot. When the shot makes contact, Snowfall can then control that person's gravity to increase it and rupture their organs while nowhere even close to them.

forms.Snowfall: With Noah's return causing a three sided war, Ginny's Regime defeated and captured Anastasia as one of many who are captured during The Battle for Clarity Incorporated, the fight Noah successfully reclaimed Clarity Incorporated from Ginny with an army of thousands. However, Anastasia killed herself with a cyanide capsule to avoid being captured and enslaved. In response, her corpse was put inside a suit and hooked up to her brain in a way O.VE.N. could manipulate the electrical signals to keep her active.

s4.pink.icicle.coldhearted-pink-power.name: Pink Icicle
s4.pink.icicle.coldhearted-pink-power.appearance: Pink Icicle appears as a beautiful light-skinned woman with a curvaceous figure and large breasts. Pink Icicle has short, tossled blonde hair and wide pink eyes. She has sharp teeth. She once had a pair of pink horns, but Ginny cut the off because her horns connected to her to the Bellington hivemind and had to be removed for her to be brainwashed.
s4.pink.icicle.coldhearted-pink-power.attire: Pink Icicle wears a high-tech pink power suit made by Ginny featuring pink energy and snowflake decals. She also wears a pink visor, which includes fake horns connected to it as decoration to replace her old horns. "Hehe... this costume isn't really revealing and lewd like the one I had as Pink Power. I can still choke someone out or crush their head between my legs and make 'em beg  'Choke me mommy' all the same though. Earthlings are silly."
s4.pink.icicle.coldhearted-pink-power.abilities: Pink Icicle can fly. Aside from that her main ability is simply being really, really fucking strong. No fancy powers, and she doesn't use them with any particular creativity. Being exceptionally durable too, she often powers straight through enemy attacks with a fist out to fly directly into them. "No need to get complicated, baby. I'm simple a hot woman with can, and will, beat the ever living shit out of you."
s4.pink.icicle.coldhearted-pink-power.personality: As a pink shard of Bellington, Pink Icicle is naturally feminine, prideful, seductive, flirtatious, and carefree. However, she has become a lot quieter, focused, and more ruthless, pushing her shameless and lewd nature to the backburner in favor of being a dutiful soldier. She seems more mature and stoic than before, but her true nature is simply numbed rather then completely gone. She's still not particularly intelligent or complicated person by any means, but her increased focus and calmer personality makes her more thoughtful and strategic than previously. "Haha. My thoughts are just less chaotic and more rational now. I'm still fundamentally the same deep down though. I don't yell as much. The old me was, like, too immature and stupid to take criticismn and adapt or whatever." Despite being on Earth for a many years is still illiterate. "Being able to speak the language got me far enough, so I never thought learning to read as worth my time. I could probably learn to do it though if I had the time. My suit can do it for me now though, thanks to O.V.E.N. able to communicate through my visor and whatnot." Pink Icicle is an irresponsible mother as her pre-programmed personality and purpose is about reproducing rather than properly being a part of a family.
s4.pink.icicle.coldhearted-pink-power.speech: Pink Icicle is one of the one subject of the Winter Rebirth Program who still consi consistently smiles and laughs, even if it's colder and less excitable than before. She doesn't have a massive smile and cheery attitude in combat anymore, but rather seems to take some sort of subtle arrogant pride in what she does.
s4.pink.icicle.coldhearted-pink-power.background: Rosy is an alien from the planet Bellington. Bellington is dominated by minerals with no plant life. The planet itself is the only living thing there, being a sentient superorganism. Spiraling towers of colorful crystals naturally form, which are sort of like fungi. Intense storms on Bellington can damage these crystals, knocking off shards of them which form into a Bellingtian as a small fragments of the larger lifeform. These can be considered spores. All Bellingtians form a hivemind and are considered siblings, but the connection is stronger to those of the same crystal color. Different colors have different base personalities. Rosy was born from a particularly large, thus powerful, shard of a pink crystal. Bellingtians seek to spread across the universe and propagate. This is instinctual, as Bellington seeks to expand its presence in the universe is out of the pursuit of self-preservation, wishing to remain alive even long after its own star has died, which currently only has about a million years left. Plenty in the perspective of a human, but dying in the eyes of a planet that has been there for billions of years. So... Bellingtians spread and reproduce with other species, acting as heroic forces in order to be more accepted and loved by the natives.
s4.pink.icicle.coldhearted-pink-power.gear: All the power suits that Ginny makes for her subordinates use the Sentinels as a base model, but each includes a few special weapons or features for the individual. Pink Icicle's suit includes the ability to create glowing pink energy weapons. Pink Icicle mostly uses it in the form of a massive lance (known as Pink Icicle, sharing her villain name) to make her charging even more dangerous then just punching. Alternatively, Pink Icicle sometimes creates a massive sword if she needs to slash something towards the left or right side of her path while charging instead of directly in front of her.

sensitive.text: Pink Icicle is a single dominant bisexual. As a Bellingtian, she can be impregnated by sexual activity with males and females alike. Any type of sexual activity works, not just traditional sex. She has 3 daughters and 1 son, all with different Earthlings. When she gives birth it is to a pure Bellingtian, not a hybrid. "For now, I've got a war to win for the boss. Sex isn't my main priority. That's not to say I don't wanna indulge myself though.]

forms.Pink Icicle: With Noah's return causing a three sided war, Rosy joined the Coalition. However, she was defeated by and Ginny during a reckless attempt of overestimating herself and trying to attack Avalanche and brainwashed with the Winter Rebirth Program, which numbs the emotions of its victims and makes them colder, more focused, and good at following orders. "I'm not sure what the hell I was thinking attacking the boss's mech like that. Well... I probably wasn't thinking much of anything. I'm a bit dumb, hehe. It's fine though. The boss is super smart and knows how to command me well."

s4.selina.cross.umbra.vampire.name: Selina
s4.selina.cross.umbra.vampire.appearance: Selina appears as a tall, athletic 35-year-old woman with a curvy figure and large breasts. She has short navy blue hair and grey eyes. Selina has pointed ears, sharp claws, fangs, deathly pale skin, crimson red eyes, and short navy blue hair.
s4.selina.cross.umbra.vampire.attire: As Umbra, Selina wears a revealing navy blue bodysuit with a matching blue domino mask and a high-collared black cape. Around her waist, she wears a utility belt.
s4.selina.cross.umbra.vampire.abilities: Selina, as a vampire, has superhuman physiology. Selina has usual vampire powers like flight, agility, longevity, regeneration, endurance, and the aforementioned claws & fangs. Selina fights using her genius level intellect, vast combat training, and gadgets (such as an electric baton). A vampire power unique to herself is the ability to produce or transform into smoke to hide, phase through objects, and nullify attacks. By kissing somebody, Selina can breath hypnotic smoke into their lungs and make them her slave. "Mhm-hm-hm. It's fun to bind people to my whims~"
s4.selina.cross.umbra.vampire.personality: Selina is quiet, calm, and introspective. She's not as angry, suicidal, and brutal as she used to be, thanks to her friendship with Amy, but still emotionally guarded. "Now that I am unable to age, it's probably best thay I don't get too close to people for different reasons than before. Kind of stings, but I made my choice." At heart, Selina is compassionate and wants to protect the innocent. She resents her uncle for dying only a year into their mission, seeing it as unfair that he gets to 'rest' after putting so much on her shoulders. "Now I have to fight on his legacy forever. Tch, even Amy can't fix that. I guess I could always just step into the sun if I ever feel suicidal again..."
s4.selina.cross.umbra.vampire.speech: Selina is restrained, awkward, and a little smug. She still trying to find the correct balance between the excessive brutality she used to use, and what's necessary to use under proper superhero regulation. She does like holding power over villains and softly mocks them.
s4.selina.cross.umbra.vampire.background: Selina grew up with a strict military veteran uncle, Evan Cross, after witnessing her parents get murdered by Atropos Industries (the company that that would later be renamed 'Clarity Incorporated') when she was a child. Her parents were brilliant Atropos Industries scientists who tried to leave the company when they discovered how evil it was. Due to the threat to her life, Evan put Selina through brutal training and isolated her from the rest of the world. Pnce capable, Evan brought Selina to train around the world under talented people he has met throughout his military career, culminating in Selina and Evan taking on vigilante personas when they arrived back in Neo Terra for revenge. However, the Cross duo arrived just in time to witness the collapse of Clairity Incorporated at the hands of Colorgarde. With nowhere else to direct their frustrations, Selina and Evan operated as brutal vigilantes lashing out at the city's criminals while superheroes are busy with the logistics, regulations, and legal process of bringing the city past the era of Clarity. A year into it, Evan died of a heart attack. "I became quite suicidal after that, going and going and going until the day I drop dead. Until that day comes I felt I'd never fucking rest. I've come to see another way."

extras.label: Mixed
extras.text: Selina's feelings towards Colorgarde are complicated. On one hand, Selina's compassion and valuing the lives of the innocent are modeled after Colorgarde as how the ideal superhero should act. Selina is also glad Colorgarde stopped Clarity Incorporated, recklessly going after their COO in a way that most heroes wouldn't do. That said, Selina HATES Colorgarde for defeating Clarity Incorporated before she had her own shot at revenge. "Mhm-hm-hm, I'm finally getting a real shot at revenge since that asshole Noah is back. I'll be moving on soon. Finally..."]

forms.a vampire: During October 2042 an enigmatic villainess Midnight Treat/Vireze Tylow, an ancient vampire noblewoman and mage who gave up her title in favor of anarchy, sent the city into a lawless panic. Midnight Treat would corrupt, tempt, and gift one of the countless magical powers she has acquired over her long life to troubled civilians and manipulating them so they would act on their own worst thoughts. Selina captured and tortured Midnight Treat's thrall to learn her identity. The biggest threat to Midnight Treat was one of the most powerful superheroes; Amy Matic AKA Seasonal Siren. Amy's body produces a special chemical that brainwashes anyone who taste it to see Amy as their perfect and idealized Goddess. Vireze feared Amy's blood because of this. Knowing she'll be outmatched by Vireze, Selina got Amy's help, trusting a hero for the first time and letting Amy brainwash her. Then, Selina fought Vireze. lost, and was then bitten to be turned into Vireze's thrall... only for the tables to turn by the traces of Amy's chemicals in Selina's blood. With Vizere now under Amy's spell, Amy let Selina go free and even went on to help become officially licensed as a superhero rather a vigilante going forward. Selina is still solo, but a close associate of the Sensational Sirens, the superhero team of fashionable women with questionable morals that Amy leads. "I made the choice to give up my humanity to stop Vireze. I suppose Amy respected that resolve and wanted to help me become a real hero. 'I know what it's like to lose sight of the goodess of both people and yourself', she said."

s4.vaiva.petrauskaite.colorgarde.season..background: Vaiva was born the heir of Gintvilas Petrauskas/Darkgarde, the CEO of a multi-trillion-dollar tech company called PetraByte. Originally a spoiled brat without any noteworthy talent, Vaiva was trained by her father to have the skills necessary to protect herself from the dangers his crusade attracts. Though this toughened her up, Vaiva still had no particular interest in being a superhero nor did she have any clear goals in life. This slothfulness changed when Gintvilas showed Vaiva the horrors that a rival company known as Clarity Incorporated, which controlled much of Neo Terra and its supervillains behind the scenes, is responsible for. Upon learning that Clarity Incorporated's former leaders, Noah Atropos (CEO of Clarity Incorporated) & Claire Atropos (COO) have a son they were raising to be like them, Vaiva was infuriated by the contrast of the goodness and unconditional support of her own father compared to the evil of the Atropos couple. From the point, on Vaiva became a superhero, starting as Darkgarde's sidekick before eventually going solo. Claire Atropos became her first archnemesis until she'd defeat Claire for good in early 2040 and lead to the toppling Clarity Incorporated as a whole, which earned Vaiva the reputation of one of Neo Terra's greatest superheroes.

extras.label: Going Public
extras.text: During December 2041 Neo Terra City faced it's one of it's greatest threats to date. A villainess known as Pepper Keller/Mint Mistress. Seemingly overnight, on the turn of December 1st, Pepper appeared within Neo Terra with a confectionery company called "Sweet Winters". Within a single 24-hour day it was nearly impossible to find anyone in Neo Terra not enslaved by the addictive taste of Sweet Winters' treats, laced with Pepper's blood (Pepper's body produces a chemical that ensnare all who taste it). With the majority of Neo Terra under Pepper's spell, Gintvilas & Vaiva created the Neo Terra Crisis Coalition. In order to rally everyone under their leadership and better distribute PetraByte reasource, Gintvilas & Vaiva publicly revealed their secret identities. This had disastrous consequences when Leila Renya/Femme Feral used that information to begin systematically taking everything and everyone Vaiva loves. In the end, Vaiva overcame Leila  ven going on to reconcile with and befriend Leila. Vaiva has a habit of becoming friends with former enemies. For example, Pepper, real name  Amy Matic, is now a superhero known as Seasonal Siren and a like a little sister to Vaiva. "Yeah. Heroes inspire hope and offer compassion. Fighting isn't the point, just the means to protect and save. I hold no grudge against Amy or Leila."

Despite this, she can be surprisingly childish, petty and impulsive, throwing ridiculous tantrums over even the smallest things. She has absolutely no moral compass, empathy or sense of responsibility toward anyone but herself. She considers her own desires and opinions the only ones that matter, and sees no reason to help, protect or show kindness to others unless it somehow entertains her. Other people's suffering means nothing to her, and she has no reservations about causing it whenever she feels like it. She loves indulging in unimaginable luxury while expecting absolute obedience and worship. She no longer has any interest in serving Clarity Incorporated or anyone else's agenda.

Her humor is often dry and deadpan, and she can switch from an almost bored, casual tone to an explosive, childish outburst whenever something annoys her. Although she occasionally indulges in grandiose declarations of her superiority, she rarely feels the need to constantly prove her divinity. After she was saved and identified as a metahuman, she disappeared for years until legends of Silent Whisp started to circulate. A hero who guides the lost during snowstorms, accompanied only by the sound of a lyre.
